translations.literal: Holding rites to set customs in order, following the king to hand down instruction—his voice and teaching reached far and were spread; no region unenlightened went unpervaded.
translations.idiomatic: He upheld rites to order the people, followed royal precedent to teach the realm; his influence reached everywhere, and none were left untouched.

sentences.zh: 爰暨木居海處之酋，被髮彫題之長，莫不忘其陋險，九譯來庭，此蓋播諸徽策，靡究其詳者也。

translations.literal: Down to chiefs who dwell in trees and live on the sea, and chieftains with loose hair and tattooed foreheads—none failed to forget their crude perils; through ninefold translation they came to court—this is broadly proclaimed in the glorious records, though the details cannot be fully traced.
translations.idiomatic: Even chiefs who live in trees or on distant shores, even leaders with tattooed faces, put aside their wild ways and came to court through layer upon layer of interpreters—widely proclaimed in the annals, though the full story exceeds what records can tell.

sentences.zh: 曩者永嘉不綱，諸夏幅裂，終古帝居，淪胥戎虜，永言園陵，率土同慕。

translations.literal: Formerly, at Yongjia when the laws were not in their proper measure, the many Xia were torn apart; from ancient times the imperial dwelling was reduced to barbarian captivity; speaking forever of the gardens and tombs—the whole land alike yearned.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yongjia era law and order collapsed and the heartland split apart; the old imperial capital fell to the barbarians; speaking of the tombs, all under Heaven mourned as one.

sentences.zh: 公明發遐慨，撫機電征，親董侯伯，稜威致討。

translations.literal: The Duke, with bright dawn of far-reaching sighs, seized the moment and swiftly campaigned; personally supervised the marquis and earls; with angular might reached and punished.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu burned with resolve; seizing the moment he marched at once, personally led the lords, and brought crushing force to bear on the enemy.

sentences.zh: 旗旝首塗，則八表響震；

translations.literal: When banners and pennants first touched the road, then the eight directions echoed in shock;
translations.idiomatic: When his banners first moved, the eight directions trembled;

sentences.zh: 偏師先路，則多壘雲徹。

translations.literal: when a detached force led the way, then many strongholds scattered like clouds driven off.
translations.idiomatic: when his vanguard advanced, fortress after fortress fell like clouds blown away.

sentences.zh: 舊都載清，五陵復禮，百城屈膝，千落影從。

translations.literal: The old capital was altogether cleared; the five mausoleums restored to ritual; a hundred cities bent the knee; a thousand settlements followed like shadows.
translations.idiomatic: The old capital was cleansed, the five tombs restored to honor; a hundred cities submitted, a thousand settlements followed in his train.

sentences.zh: 自篇籍所載，生民以來，勳德懋功，未有若此之盛者也。

translations.literal: From what the written records carry, since the birth of the people, meritorious virtue and abundant achievement—none has been so great as this.
translations.idiomatic: In all the records since the beginning of mankind, no merit has ever matched this in scale.

sentences.zh: 昔周、呂佐叡聖之主，因三分之形，把旄仗鉞，一時指麾，皆大啟疆宇，跨州兼國。

translations.literal: Formerly Zhou and Lü aided the sage sovereign; relying on the shape of the Three Parts, grasping yak-tail banners and battle-axes, at one stroke commanding—all greatly opened territory and crossed provinces to hold kingdoms.
translations.idiomatic: In old times Zhou Gong and Lü Wang served sage rulers; at a stroke of command, banner and battle-axe in hand, they opened vast territories spanning many provinces.

sentences.zh: 其在桓、文，方茲尤儉，然亦顯被寵章，光錫殊品。

translations.literal: Even in the cases of Huan and Wen, compared with this they were markedly restrained—yet even so they were clearly clothed in favors and seals, brightly bestowed extraordinary ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Even Duke Huan and Duke Wen, though far less than this in achievement, still received lavish honors and exceptional rank.

sentences.zh: 況乃獨絕百代，顧邈前烈者哉！

translations.literal: How much more one who alone surpasses a hundred generations and looks back to distant forefathers!
translations.idiomatic: How much more then for one who stands alone above all the ages and looks back on even the greatest of the past!

sentences.zh: 朕每弘鑒古訓，思遵令圖。

translations.literal: We each time broadly mirror the ancient instruction and think to follow the present plan.
translations.idiomatic: We have ever looked to the ancient teaching and sought to follow the right course.

sentences.zh: 以公深秉沖挹，用闕大禮，天人引領，于茲歷載。

translations.literal: Because the Duke deeply upholds modest restraint, thereby omitting the great rites—the people and Heaven stretch their necks in this for years already.
translations.idiomatic: Because Gaozu in deep humility has declined the grand honors, Heaven and the people have waited for years.

sentences.zh: 況今禹迹齊軌，九隩同文，司勳抗策，普天增佇。

translations.literal: How much more now that Yu's traces run level on the same track, the nine borderlands share the same script, and the merit office raises its bamboo tally—the whole Heaven's people increase in expectation.
translations.idiomatic: Now the empire stands united, the far borders share one script, and the whole realm awaits the reward of merit.

sentences.zh: 遂公高挹，大愆國章，三靈眷屬，朕實祗懼。

translations.literal: Yet the Duke's lofty restraint has greatly violated the state's statutes; the Three Numina look upon him with favor—We are truly reverently fearful.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Gaozu's continued refusal greatly breaches royal protocol; Heaven, Earth, and the spirits approve—and We are deeply awed.

sentences.zh: 便宜顯答羣望，允崇盛典。

translations.literal: It is fitting clearly to answer the multitude's hopes and truly to exalt the grand ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: It is right to answer the people's hope and grant the supreme honors they deserve.

sentences.zh: 其進位相國，總百揆，揚州牧，封十郡為宋公，備九錫之禮，加璽綬、遠遊冠，位在諸侯王上，加相國綠綟綬。

translations.literal: He is to advance to the rank of Chancellor of State, oversee the hundred officials, Governor of Yangzhou, enfeoff with ten commanderies as Duke of Song, provided the rites of the Nine Bestowals, add seal cord and the Far-Wandering cap, rank above the feudal princes and kings, and add the green sash of Chancellor of State.
translations.idiomatic: Let him be made Chancellor of State, overseer of all offices and Governor of Yangzhou, enfeoffed as Duke of Song over ten commanderies, granted the Nine Bestowals, the seal and Far-Wandering cap, rank above all princes, and the chancellor's green sash.

sentences.zh: 策曰：

translations.literal: The citation said:
translations.idiomatic: The investiture document read:

sentences.zh: 朕以寡昧，仰贊洪基，夷羿乘釁，蕩覆王室，越在南鄙，遷于九江。

translations.literal: We, being solitary and dim, look upward to assist the great foundation; Yi of the Yi seized the chance, swept and overturned the royal house, crossed to the southern borderlands, and moved to the Nine Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: We, feeble and untested, lean on the great foundation of the throne. When Yi usurped power and overturned the dynasty, the court fled south to the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 宗祀絕饗，人神無位，提挈羣凶，寄命江滸。

translations.literal: Ancestral sacrifices were cut off from offerings; men and spirits had no allotted place; dragging along the crowd of villains, We entrusted Our fate to the river's bank.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestral rites were cut off; men and spirits lost their proper place; We clung to a crowd of villains on the Yangzi's bank.

sentences.zh: 則我祖宗之業，奄墜于地，七百之祚，翦焉既傾，若涉淵海，罔知攸濟。

translations.literal: Then Our ancestors' enterprise suddenly fell to earth; the seven hundred years' fortune was already sheared and toppled; as if wading a deep abyss—we knew not by what to cross.
translations.idiomatic: Our forefathers' legacy collapsed; seven centuries of fortune was cut short; We were as one drowning in a deep sea with no way to shore.

sentences.zh: 天未絕晉，誕育英輔，振厥弛維，再造區宇，興亡繼絕，俾昏作明。

translations.literal: Heaven had not yet cut off Jin; it brought forth an heroic aide; he shook up the slackened bonds; again made the realm; revived what was perishing and continued what was cut off; made the dark become bright.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven had not abandoned Jin; it raised up a great helper who tightened the loose bonds of state, remade the realm, restored what was dying, and turned darkness into light.

sentences.zh: 元勳至德，朕實賴焉。

translations.literal: Primary merit and supreme virtue—We truly rely on him.
translations.idiomatic: On this supreme merit and virtue We truly rely.

sentences.zh: 今將授公典策，其敬聽朕命：

translations.literal: Now about to confer on the Duke the canonical citation, reverently listen to Our command:
translations.idiomatic: We now confer the canonical investiture upon Gaozu. Hear Our command:

sentences.zh: 乃者桓玄肆僭，滔天泯夏，拔本塞源，顛倒六位，庶僚俛眉，四方莫卹。

translations.literal: Formerly Huan Xuan unrestrainedly usurped; floods to Heaven and extinguished Xia; uprooted the root and blocked the source; inverted the Six Positions; the multitude of officials bowed eyebrows; the four quarters none showed care.
translations.idiomatic: When Huan Xuan seized the throne, his crime flooded Heaven, uprooting the foundation and inverting the cosmic order; officials bowed their heads and none in the four quarters dared to care.

sentences.zh: 公精貫朝日，氣凌霄漢，奮其靈武，大殲羣慝，剋復皇邑，奉帝歆神。

translations.literal: The Duke's spirit pierced the morning sun, his breath over-topped the Milky Way; he roused his numinous martial power; greatly exterminated the crowd of evil; overcame and recovered the imperial city; presented the emperor to the savoring of spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu's spirit pierced the morning sun, his valor rose to the heavens; he roused divine martial power, destroyed the wicked host, retook the capital, and restored the emperor to the altars.

sentences.zh: 此公之大節，[7]始於勤王者也。

translations.literal: This is the Duke's great constancy, [7] beginning from the king's loyal service.
translations.idiomatic: This was Gaozu's supreme loyalty, [7] his first great deed in serving the throne.

sentences.zh: 授律羣后，泝流長騖，薄伐崢嶸，獻捷南郢，大憝折首，羣逆畢夷，三光旋采，舊物反正。

translations.literal: Transferring the law to the host of lords, upstream for a long gallop, lightly campaigning against the rugged heights, presenting victory at Southern Ying—the great enemy's head broken, the crowd of rebels all extinguished; the three luminaries turned their brilliance; old things returned to the right.
translations.idiomatic: He gave the law to the lords and drove upstream in long pursuit; he struck the rugged south and reported victory at Southern Ying; the chief rebel was beheaded, all traitors destroyed; the heavenly lights shone again and the realm was restored.

sentences.zh: 此又公之功也。

translations.literal: This too is the Duke's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: This too was Gaozu's merit.

sentences.zh: 出藩入輔，弘茲保弼，阜財利用，繁殖生民，編戶歲滋，疆宇日啟，導德明刑，四境有截。

translations.literal: Going out to the frontier and entering as aide, he expanded this protective support; enriched goods and benefited use; multiplied the living people; registered households yearly increased; territory daily opened; guided virtue and clarified punishments—the four borders had boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: Whether governing the frontier or aiding the court, he enriched the realm, grew the people, expanded registered households and territory day by day, guided by virtue and clear law until the four borders were secure.

sentences.zh: 此又公之功也。

translations.literal: This too is the Duke's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: This too was Gaozu's merit.

sentences.zh: 鮮卑負眾，僭盜三齊，狼噬冀、青，虔劉沂、岱，介恃遐阻，仍為邊毒。

translations.literal: The Xianbei, relying on their multitude, usurped and stole the Three Qi; wolf-like devoured Ji and Qing; reverent-sword slaughtered Yi and Dai; depended on distant barriers and continued as a border poison.
translations.idiomatic: The Xianbei, swollen with numbers, seized the Three Qi, ravaged Ji and Qing, slaughtered their way to Yi and Mount Tai, and leaning on distant barriers continued to plague the borders.

sentences.zh: 公蒐乘秣駟，敻入遠疆，衝櫓四臨，萬雉俱潰，竊號之虜，顯戮司寇，拓土三千，申威龍漠。

translations.literal: The Duke gathered chariots and foddered the four-horse teams, far entered the distant border; assault towers on four sides; ten thousand ramparts all collapsed; the usurping-title barbarians openly executed by the Minister of Justice; territory expanded three thousand; authority proclaimed at the Dragon Desert.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu mustered chariots and horses and marched deep into the frontier; siege engines closed on every side and a thousand walls fell; the usurping barbarians were publicly executed; he opened three thousand li of territory and proclaimed his might to the northern desert.

sentences.zh: 此又公之功也。

translations.literal: This too is the Duke's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: This too was Gaozu's merit.

sentences.zh: 盧循妖凶，伺隙五嶺，乘虛肆逆，侵覆江、豫，旍拂寰內，矢及王城，朝野喪沮，莫有固志，家獻徙卜之計，國議遷都之規。

translations.literal: Lu Xun, demonic and vicious, watched for a gap in the Five Ridges, seized the void and unrestrainedly rebelled; invaded and overturned Jiang and Yu; his banners swept the realm within; arrows reached the royal city; court and countryside lost heart and despaired; none had a firm will; households offered plans for moving and divining; the state deliberated schemes for shifting the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Xun, that demon of rebellion, watched for a gap among the Five Ridges and struck when the realm was open; he overran Jiang and Yu, his banners swept the empire, his arrows reached the capital; court and country lost heart; households urged flight and the state debated moving the capital.

sentences.zh: 公乘轅南濟，義形于色，嶷然內湛，視嶮若夷，攄略運奇，英謨不世，狡寇窮衂，喪旗宵遁，俾我畿甸，拯於將墜。

translations.literal: The Duke mounted the carriage-shafts and crossed the Yangzi south; righteousness showed in his countenance; toweringly still within; viewed peril as level plain; deployed strategy and wielded the extraordinary; heroic plans unmatched in the age; the cunning foe exhausted and wounded; lost banners and fled by night; caused Our capital domain to be saved from the verge of falling.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu crossed the Yangzi south with righteous fury in his face, calm amid danger as on level ground; his unmatched stratagems drove the cunning foe wounded into flight by night and saved the capital domain from collapse.

sentences.zh: 此又公之功也。

translations.literal: This too is the Duke's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: This too was Gaozu's merit.

sentences.zh: 追奔逐北，揚旍江濆，偏旅浮海，指日遄至。

translations.literal: Pursuing the fleeing and chasing the routed, he raised banners on the river's bank; a detached force floated on the sea; within sight of a day swiftly arrived.
translations.idiomatic: He chased the fleeing foe, raised his banners on the riverbank; a detached force sailed the sea and arrived within days.

sentences.zh: 番禺之功，俘級萬數，左里之捷，魚潰鳥散。

translations.literal: At the achievement at Panyu, captives and severed heads numbered in the tens of thousands; at the victory at Zuoli, fish scattered and birds dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: At Panyu his captives numbered in the thousands; at Zuoli the enemy broke like fish and scattered like birds.

sentences.zh: 元凶遠迸，傳首萬里，海南肅清，荒服來款。

translations.literal: The chief culprit fled far; his head was transmitted ten thousand li; Hainan was altogether cleared; the wild domains came to pledge obedience.
translations.idiomatic: The chief rebel fled far; his head was sent a thousand miles; the south was cleared and distant tribes came to submit.

sentences.zh: 此又公之功也。

translations.literal: This too is the Duke's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: This too was Gaozu's merit.

sentences.zh: 劉毅叛換，負釁西夏，凌上罔主，志肆姦暴，附麗協黨，扇蕩王畿。

translations.literal: Liu Yi rebelled and changed sides; bearing guilt in Western Xia; over-topping the sovereign and deceiving the ruler; his will unrestrainedly wicked and violent; attaching to faction and coordinating parties; fanned and swept the royal precincts.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yi rebelled in the west, guilty and defiant, lording over his sovereign with violent ambition; he gathered factions and stirred turmoil in the capital region.

sentences.zh: 公御軌以刑，消之不日，倉兕電泝，神兵風掃，罪人斯得，荊、衡清晏。

translations.literal: The Duke met him with track and punishment; extinguished him within days; the azure rhinoceros lightning-like upstream; divine troops wind-swept; the guilty man was obtained; Jing and Heng were cleared and at peace.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu met him with law and arms and destroyed him within days; his fleet drove upstream like lightning, his troops swept like wind; the traitor was taken and Jing and Heng were pacified.

sentences.zh: 此又公之功也。

translations.literal: This too is the Duke's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: This too was Gaozu's merit.

sentences.zh: 譙縱怙亂，寇竊一隅，王化阻閡，三巴淪溺。

translations.literal: Qiao Zong relied on disorder; as a raider stole one corner; royal transformation was blocked and impeded; the Three Ba were drowned and submerged.
translations.idiomatic: Qiao Zong relied on chaos and seized a corner of the realm; royal influence was blocked and the Three Ba drowned in war.

sentences.zh: 公指命偏師，授以良圖，凌波浮湍，致屆井絡，僭豎伏鑕，梁、岷草偃。

translations.literal: The Duke pointed and commissioned a detached force; granted a good plan; crossed waves and floated on rapids; reached and arrived at the well-net of channels; the usurping rogue submitted to the axe; Liang and Min grass lay flat.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu sent a detached force with a clear plan; they crossed rivers and rapids to reach the Shu basin; the usurper submitted to the axe and Liang and Min bowed like grass before the wind.

sentences.zh: 此又公之功也。

translations.literal: This too is the Duke's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: This too was Gaozu's merit.

sentences.zh: 馬休、魯宗，阻兵內侮，驅率二方，連旗稱亂。

translations.literal: Ma Xiu and Lu Zong blocked arms and insulted within; drove and led the two regions; joined banners and declared rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xiu and Lu Zong raised troops in rebellion, rousing two regions under their banners.

sentences.zh: 公投袂星言，研其上略，江津之師，勢踰風電，迴斾沔川，實繁震懾，二叛奔迸，荊、雍來蘇，玄澤浸育，溫風潛被。

translations.literal: The Duke, casting sleeves, set out at starlight; refined the supreme strategy; at the Yangzi crossing the army's momentum exceeded wind and lightning; turned banners at the Mian River—the host truly multiplied in shock and awe; the two rebels fled in rout; Jing and Yong came back to life; dark favor soaked and nourished; warm winds secretly spread.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu set out at once with a master plan; at the Yangzi crossing his army moved faster than wind and lightning; turning his banners at the Mian River he struck terror; the two rebels fled; Jing and Yong revived; his deep mercy spread like a hidden warm wind.

sentences.zh: 此又公之功也。

translations.literal: This too is the Duke's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: This too was Gaozu's merit.

sentences.zh: 永嘉不競，四夷擅華，五都幅裂，山陵幽辱，祖宗懷沒世之憤，遺氓有匪風之思。

translations.literal: At Yongjia when there was no strength of contest, the four barbarians monopolized Hua; the Five Capitals were torn apart; mountains and tombs suffered hidden disgrace; ancestors harbored fury until death's end; surviving commoners had thoughts of the unrighteous wind.
translations.idiomatic: After the Yongjia disaster the barbarians held the heartland; the five capitals were torn apart and the imperial tombs desecrated; the dead ancestors seethed with unending wrath and the survivors yearned for righteousness.

sentences.zh: 公遠齊伊宰納隍之仁，近同小白滅亡之恥，鞠旅陳師，赫然大號，分命羣帥，北徇司、兗。

translations.literal: The Duke, afar matching the Yi minister's virtue of accepting the moat; near sharing Small Bai's shame of annihilation; mustered troops and arrayed the host; brilliantly raised the great cry; divided commands to the crowd of marshals; northward advanced through Si and Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu matched the ancient minister's mercy and shared Duke Huan's shame at national ruin; he mustered his armies, raised a great cry, sent his generals north into Si and Yan.

sentences.zh: 許、鄭風靡，鞏、洛載清，偽牧逆藩，交臂請罪，百年榛穢，一朝掃滌。

translations.literal: Xu and Zheng wind-scattered; Gong and Luo were loaded with clarity; pretender governors and rebellious frontier lords, arms crossed, begged guilt; a hundred years of thorn and filth—in one morning swept clean.
translations.idiomatic: Xu and Zheng fell before him; Gong and Luoyang were cleansed; pretender governors and rebel lords surrendered with arms bound; a century of ruin was swept away in a single morning.

sentences.zh: [8]此又公之功也。

translations.literal: [8] This too is the Duke's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: [8] This too was Gaozu's merit.

sentences.zh: 公有康宇內之勳，重之以明德。

translations.literal: The Duke has the achievement of bringing peace within the realm, doubled with bright virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu has brought peace to the realm, crowned with luminous virtue.

sentences.zh: 爰初發迹，則奇謨冠古，電擊強妖，則鋒無前對，聿寧東畿，大造黔首。

translations.literal: From the first emergence of his track—then his extraordinary plans topped antiquity; lightning-struck the strong demons—then no blade-point had a match before him; thereupon pacified the eastern capital domain; greatly made the black-haired people.
translations.idiomatic: From his first rise his plans surpassed all antiquity; when he struck the powerful demons none stood before his blade; he pacified the eastern capital and wrought great good for the people.

sentences.zh: 若乃草昧經綸，化融於歲計，扶危靜亂，道固於苞桑。

translations.literal: As for founding in darkness and ordering the threads—transformation melted within the year's reckoning; sustaining peril and stilling disorder—the Way was firm as wrapped mulberry.
translations.idiomatic: In founding the state amid chaos his governance matured year by year; in sustaining peril and stilling disorder his Way was firm as the mulberry in a storm.

sentences.zh: 辯方正位，納之軌度，蠲削煩苛，較若畫一，淳風美化，盈塞宇宙。

translations.literal: Discriminating direction and setting positions, bringing them within track and measure; remitting and cutting away troublesome harshness, compared as if drawn with one stroke; pure wind and beautified transformation filled and blocked the cosmos.
translations.idiomatic: He set things in their proper place and brought them under law; he cut away harsh burdens until all was uniform; his pure influence filled the universe.

sentences.zh: 是以絕域獻琛，遐夷納貢，王略所宣，九服率從。

translations.literal: For this reason the farthest regions presented gems; distant barbarians paid tribute; where the king's strategy was proclaimed—the nine services all followed.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the farthest lands sent tribute and distant peoples brought gifts; wherever royal policy reached, all the realm followed.

sentences.zh: 雖文命之東漸西被，咎繇之邁于種德，何以尚茲。

translations.literal: Although Yu the Great spread east and covered west, and Gao Yao advanced in planting virtue—how could they surpass this?
translations.idiomatic: Even the virtue of Yu the Great, spreading east and west, and of Gao Yao, planting merit far and wide, cannot match what you have done.

sentences.zh: 朕聞先王之宰世也，庸勳尊賢，建侯胙土，褒以寵章，崇其徽物，所以協輔皇家，永隆藩屏。

translations.literal: We have heard that when the former kings governed the world, they employed merit and honored the worthy, established feudal lords and enfeoffed them with land, rewarded them with favor-granting regalia, and exalted their emblematic objects—thereby to assist and support the royal house and forever elevate the screen of the frontiers.
translations.idiomatic: We have heard that the ancient kings ruled by rewarding merit, honoring the worthy, enfeoffing lords with land, and granting them honors and emblems, so that they might assist the throne and guard the realm forever.

sentences.zh: 故曲阜光啟，遂荒徐宅，營丘表海，四履有聞。

translations.literal: Therefore Qufu was gloriously opened, and the Xu domain was brought to waste; Yingqiu faced the sea, and its fame was heard in the four treads.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the house of Lu was ennobled at Qufu and held Xu; Qi was established at Yingqiu by the sea, and their fame reached the four quarters.

sentences.zh: 其在襄王，亦賴匡霸，又命晉文，備物光錫。

translations.literal: In the time of King Xiang of Zhou, he too relied on one who rectified hegemony; again Duke Wen of Jin was commanded, and full gifts were brightly bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: King Xiang of Zhou relied on a lord who restored hegemony; Duke Wen of Jin too received the full ceremonial gifts.

sentences.zh: 惟公道冠前烈，勳高振古，而殊典未加，朕甚懵焉。

translations.literal: Only the Duke, in Way crowns the former worthies and merit towers to shake antiquity—yet special statutes have not been added; We are very bewildered indeed.
translations.idiomatic: Your Way surpasses the heroes of old and your merit shakes antiquity, yet the highest honors have not been granted you. We are deeply troubled.

sentences.zh: 今進授相國，以徐州之彭城沛蘭陵下邳淮陽山陽廣陵、兗州之高平魯泰山十郡，封公為宋公。

translations.literal: Now We advance and appoint you Chancellor of State, with the ten commanderies Pengcheng, Pei, Lanling, Xiapi, Huaiyang, Shanyang, and Guangling of Xuzhou, and Gaoping, Lu, and Taishan of Yanzhou, and enfeoff you as Duke of Song.
translations.idiomatic: We now appoint you Chancellor of State and enfeoff you as Duke of Song over ten commanderies: Pengcheng, Pei, Lanling, Xiapi, Huaiyang, Shanyang, and Guangling in Xuzhou, and Gaoping, Lu, and Taishan in Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 錫茲玄土，苴以白茅，爰定爾居，用建冢社。

translations.literal: We bestow this dark earth, wrap it with white thatch, thereby fix your dwelling, and use it to establish your ancestral altar.
translations.idiomatic: We grant you the sacred earth wrapped in white thatch, fix your seat, and establish your ancestral shrine.

sentences.zh: 昔晉、鄭啟藩，入作卿士，周、邵保傅，出總二南，內外之重，公實兼之。

translations.literal: Formerly Jin and Zheng opened their principalities and entered to serve as ministers; Zhou and Shao guarded and tutored, and going forth they oversaw the Two Souths—the weight of inner and outer—you, Duke, truly combine both.
translations.idiomatic: Jin and Zheng once opened their domains and became ministers at court; the Duke of Zhou and Duke of Shao guarded the heir within and governed without. You, Duke, hold both burdens.

sentences.zh: 今命使持節、兼太尉、尚書左僕射、晉寧縣五等男湛授相國印綬，[9]宋公璽紱；

translations.literal: Now We command the Bearer of the Staff, concurrently Grand Commandant, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, and Baron of the fifth rank of Jinning county, Zhan, to confer the Chancellor of States seal and cord, [9] and the Duke of Songs seal and ribbon;
translations.idiomatic: We command Zhan, Bearer of the Staff, Grand Commandant, and Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, to confer the seal and cord of Chancellor of State [9] and the seal and ribbon of Duke of Song;

sentences.zh: 使持節、兼司空、散騎常侍、尚書、陽遂鄉侯泰授宋公茅土，金虎符第一至第五左，[10]竹使符第一至第十左。

translations.literal: the Bearer of the Staff, concurrently Minister of Works, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, Master of Writing, and Marquis of Yangsui township, Tai, to confer the Duke of Songs fief-soil, gold tiger tallies first through fifth on the left, [10] and bamboo envoy tallies first through tenth on the left.
translations.idiomatic: and Tai, Bearer of the Staff, Minister of Works, and Master of Writing, to confer the fief-soil of Song, gold tiger tallies one through five on the left, [10] and bamboo envoy tallies one through ten on the left.

sentences.zh: 相國位無不總，禮絕朝班，居常之名，宜與事革。

translations.literal: The Chancellor of States position has nothing it does not oversee; his ritual stands apart from the court ranks—ordinary titles should be reformed along with the affair.
translations.idiomatic: The Chancellor of State oversees all affairs and stands above the court ranks; his ordinary titles should be changed accordingly.

sentences.zh: 其以相國總百揆，[11]去「錄尚書」之號。

translations.literal: Let him, as Chancellor of State, oversee the hundred offices, [11] and remove the title "Recorder of the Masters of Writing."
translations.idiomatic: Let him as Chancellor of State oversee all government [11] and drop the title Recorder of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 上送所假節、侍中貂蟬、中外都督太傅太尉印綬，[12]豫章公印策。

translations.literal: He shall send up the borrowed staff, Palace Attendants sable cicada, seals and cords of Grand Tutor and Grand Commandant of the inner and outer command, [12] and the seal and patent of Duke of Yuzhang.
translations.idiomatic: He shall return the borrowed staff, the Palace Attendants insignia, the seals of Grand Tutor and Grand Commandant, [12] and the seal and patent of Duke of Yuzhang.

sentences.zh: 進揚州牧，領征西將軍、司豫北徐雍四州刺史如故。

translations.literal: He is advanced as Governor of Yangzhou, continuing as before as Campaigning-west General and Governor of the four provinces Si, Yu, Northern Xu, and Yong.
translations.idiomatic: He is advanced to Governor of Yangzhou and continues as Campaigning-west General and governor of Si, Yu, Northern Xu, and Yong.

sentences.zh: 公紀綱禮度，萬國是式，乘介蹈方，罔有遷志。

translations.literal: The Duke, in statutes and ritual measure, is the model for ten thousand states; riding the go-between and treading the square, he has no shifting intent.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke sets statutes and ritual for all states, holds his course without wavering, and never turns aside.

sentences.zh: 是以錫公大輅、戎輅各一，玄牡二駟。

translations.literal: Therefore We bestow on the Duke one great carriage and one war carriage, and two teams of black stallions.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore We bestow one state carriage and one war carriage, and two teams of black stallions.

sentences.zh: 公抑末敦本，務農重積，采蘩實殷，稼穡惟阜。

translations.literal: The Duke restrains the branch and honors the root, devotes himself to agriculture and values stores; picking artemisia is truly abundant, and the crops are luxuriant.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke restrains luxury and honors the root, devotes himself to farming and stores grain; the harvest is rich and the fields abundant.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公袞冕之服，赤舄副焉。

translations.literal: For this We bestow on the Duke the robe and cap of nine emblems, with red shoes besides.
translations.idiomatic: For this We bestow the robe and cap of nine emblems, with red shoes.

sentences.zh: 公閑邪納正，移風改俗，陶鈞品物，如樂之和。

translations.literal: The Duke restrains evil and receives the upright, shifts the wind and changes custom, potters and balances all things like the harmony of music.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke restrains evil and upholds the upright, transforms customs, and molds all things in harmony like music.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公軒縣之樂，六佾之舞。

translations.literal: For this We bestow on the Duke the music of the suspended bells, and the dance of six rows.
translations.idiomatic: For this We bestow the music of suspended bells and the six-row dance.

sentences.zh: 公宣美王化，導揚休風，華夷企踵，遠人胥萃。

translations.literal: The Duke proclaims the beautiful royal transformation, guides and raises excellent custom; Chinese and barbarian stand on tiptoe, and distant men all gather.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke proclaims the royal transformation and excellent custom; Chinese and barbarian alike look to him, and distant peoples gather.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公朱戶以居。

translations.literal: For this We bestow on the Duke vermilion doors to dwell in.
translations.idiomatic: For this We bestow vermilion doors for his dwelling.

sentences.zh: 公官方任能，網羅幽滯，九臯辭野，髦士盈朝。

translations.literal: The Duke, in office, employs the able, nets the hidden and stagnant; the nine marshes send forth from the wild, and eminent scholars fill the court.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke in office employs the able and draws forth the neglected; talents emerge from obscurity and fill the court.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公納陛以登。

translations.literal: For this We bestow on the Duke the covered ramp to ascend.
translations.idiomatic: For this We bestow the covered ramp for his ascent.

sentences.zh: 公當軸處中，率下以義，式遏寇讎，清除苛慝。

translations.literal: The Duke, at the hub and in the center, leads those below by righteousness, checks the bandit foe, and clears away harsh evil.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke stands at the center, leads by righteousness, checks the enemy, and clears away harsh wrongs.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公虎賁之士三百人。

translations.literal: For this We bestow on the Duke three hundred tiger-guardsmen.
translations.idiomatic: For this We bestow three hundred tiger guards.

sentences.zh: 公明罰恤刑，庶獄詳允，放命干紀，罔有攸縱。

translations.literal: The Duke clarifies punishments and pities in sentencing; the many prisons are examined and approved; those who defy orders and violate discipline—none are left to roam free.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke clarifies punishments and shows mercy in judgment; prisons are justly decided; rebels against order are not spared.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公鈇、鉞各一。

translations.literal: For this We bestow on the Duke one battle-axe and one great-axe.
translations.idiomatic: For this We bestow one battle-axe and one great-axe.

sentences.zh: 公龍驤鳳矯，咫尺八紘，括囊四海，折衝無外。

translations.literal: The Duke, dragon-soaring and phoenix-rising, within a foot the eight cords; he enfolds the four seas in a bag and repels the foe without.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke rises like dragon and phoenix; within a foot lie the eight directions; he holds the four seas and repels all foes abroad.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公彤弓一，彤矢百，盧弓十，盧矢千。

translations.literal: For this We bestow on the Duke one red bow, one hundred red arrows, ten black bows, and one thousand black arrows.
translations.idiomatic: For this We bestow one red bow, one hundred red arrows, ten black bows, and one thousand black arrows.

sentences.zh: 公溫恭孝思，致虔禋祀，忠肅之志，儀刑萬方。

translations.literal: The Duke is warm, respectful, and filially mindful; he extends utmost sincerity in suburban sacrifice; his loyal and solemn intent is the model for ten thousand regions.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke is warm, respectful, and filial; he is utmost in suburban sacrifice; his loyal solemnity is the model for all lands.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公秬鬯一卣，圭瓚副焉。

translations.literal: For this We bestow on the Duke one jar of black millet ale, with a jade libation cup besides.
translations.idiomatic: For this We bestow one jar of black millet ale and a jade libation cup.

sentences.zh: 宋國置丞相以下，一遵舊儀。

translations.literal: In the state of Song, from Chancellor of State downward, all follow the old statutes.
translations.idiomatic: In the state of Song, from the chancellor downward, all follow the former statutes.

sentences.zh: 欽哉！

translations.literal: Reverently!
translations.idiomatic: Reverently!

sentences.zh: 其祗服往命，茂對天休，簡恤庶邦，敬敷顯德，以終我高祖之嘉命。

translations.literal: Respectfully take on the command you go to, richly respond to Heavens favor, simply comfort the many states, respectfully spread bright virtue, and thereby complete Our High Ancestors excellent mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Respectfully accept this command, answer Heavens favor, comfort the many states, spread bright virtue, and complete Our High Ancestors mandate.

sentences.zh: 置宋國侍中、黃門侍郎、尚書左丞、郎，隨大使奉迎。

translations.literal: Establish in the state of Song Palace Attendants, Gentlemen of the Yellow Gate, Left Assistant of the Masters of Writing, and Gentlemen, to follow the great envoy in welcoming.
translations.idiomatic: Establish Palace Attendants, Gentlemen of the Yellow Gate, the Left Assistant of the Masters of Writing, and Gentlemen in the state of Song, to follow the great envoy in welcoming the regalia.

translations.literal: Citation marker in the source text: [13].
translations.idiomatic: Editorial note marker in the source: [13].

sentences.zh: 枹罕虜乞佛熾槃遣使詣公求効力討羌，拜平西將軍、河南公。

translations.literal: The barbarian of Baohan, Qifu Chipan, sent envoys to the Duke to offer service in attacking the Qiang; he was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Duke of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Qifu Chipan of Baohan sent envoys to offer service against the Qiang; he was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Duke of Henan.

sentences.zh: 十三年正月，公以舟師進討，留彭城公義隆鎮彭城。

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirteenth year, the Duke advanced by river army to attack; he left Prince of Pengcheng Yilong to guard Pengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the thirteenth year the Duke marched by river to attack; Prince of Pengcheng Yilong was left to guard Pengcheng.

sentences.zh: 軍次留城，經張良廟，令曰：「夫盛德不泯，義在祀典，微管之歎，撫事彌深。

translations.literal: The army halted at Liucheng and passed Zhang Liangs temple; he issued an order: "Great virtue is not extinguished; righteousness lies in the sacrificial canon. The sigh over the small share of Guan Zhong—the more one dwells on the matter, the deeper it runs.
translations.idiomatic: The army halted at Liucheng and passed Zhang Liangs temple. He issued an order: "Great virtue is never lost; righteousness belongs in the sacrificial canon. The sigh over Guan Zhong—the more one reflects, the deeper the feeling.

sentences.zh: 張子房道亞黃中，照隣殆庶，風雲玄感，[14]蔚為帝師，大拯橫流，夷項定漢，固以參軌伊、望，冠德如仁。

translations.literal: Zhang Zifang: his Way was next to the yellow center, his illumination neighbored the near common; wind and cloud responded in mystery, [14] and he rose to be the emperors teacher; he greatly rescued the crosswise flood, leveled Xiang and settled Han—thus he may be ranked with Yi and Wang, and his crowning virtue was like benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zifang stood next to the center of the realm and shone on all near him; wind and cloud answered in mystery [14] and he became the emperors teacher; he rescued the realm from flood, overthrew Xiang, and settled Han—equal to Yi Yin and Lü Wang, his virtue crowned with benevolence.

sentences.zh: 若乃神交圯上，道契商洛，顯晦之間，窈然難究，源流淵浩，莫測其端矣。

translations.literal: As for his spirit-meeting on the ruined wall, his Way joined with Shangluo—between the manifest and the hidden it is remote and hard to fathom; the source-stream is deep and vast, and none can measure its end.
translations.idiomatic: His meeting with the old man on the ruined wall and his bond with Shangluo lie between manifest and hidden, remote and hard to fathom; the source is deep and vast beyond measure.

sentences.zh: 塗次舊沛，佇駕留城，靈廟荒殘，遺象陳昧，撫迹懷人，慨然永歎。

translations.literal: Passing by on the road through old Pei, halting the chariot at Liucheng—the spirit temple was desolate and ruined, the surviving images dim; stroking the traces and cherishing the man, he sighed long in emotion.
translations.idiomatic: Passing old Pei and halting at Liucheng, he found the spirit temple ruined and the images faded; stroking the traces and cherishing the man, he sighed long.

sentences.zh: 過大梁者或佇想於夷門，遊九原者亦流連於隨會。

translations.literal: Those who passed Daliang perhaps stood in thought at the Yi Gate; those who traveled the Nine Mounds also lingered at Sui Hui.
translations.idiomatic: Travelers at Daliang paused in thought at the Yi Gate; those at the Nine Mounds lingered over Sui Hui.

sentences.zh: 可改構榱桷，修飾丹青，蘋蘩行潦，以時致薦。

translations.literal: The timbers and rafters may be rebuilt, the cinnabar and green restored; duckweed and gathered water may be offered in season.
translations.idiomatic: Rebuild the timbers and rafters, restore the painted colors, and offer duckweed and gathered water in season.

sentences.zh: 以紓懷古之情，用存不刊之烈。

translations.literal: Thus to ease the feeling of cherishing antiquity, and thereby preserve his undying splendor.
translations.idiomatic: Thus to ease the heart that cherishes antiquity and preserve his undying fame.

sentences.zh: 」天子追贈公祖為太常，父為左光祿大夫，讓不受。

translations.literal: " The Son of Heaven posthumously honored the Dukes grandfather as Grand Master of Splendor and his father as Left Grand Master of Splendor; he declined and did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven posthumously honored the Dukes grandfather as Grand Master of Splendor and his father as Left Grand Master of Splendor; he declined and did not accept.

sentences.zh: 二月，冠軍將軍檀道濟等次潼關。

translations.literal: In the second month, Champion General Tan Daoji and others halted at Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Champion General Tan Daoji and others camped at Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 三月庚辰，大軍入河。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen in the third month, the great army entered the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day in the third month the main army crossed into the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 索虜步騎十萬，營據河津。

translations.literal: The Northern barbarians infantry and cavalry in the tens of thousands camped and held the river ford.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Di infantry and cavalry, one hundred thousand strong, held the river crossing.

sentences.zh: 公命諸軍濟河擊破之。

translations.literal: The Duke ordered the armies to cross the river and struck and broke them.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke ordered the armies to cross the river and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 公至洛陽。

translations.literal: The Duke reached Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke reached Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 七月，至陝城。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, he reached Shancheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he reached Shancheng.

sentences.zh: 龍驤將軍王鎮惡伐木為舟，自河浮渭。

translations.literal: Dragon-soaring General Wang Zhen’e felled trees to make boats and floated from the Yellow River onto the Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Dragon-soaring General Wang Zhen’e felled trees for boats and sailed from the Yellow River onto the Wei.

sentences.zh: 八月，扶風太守沈田子大破姚泓於藍田。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Fufeng Administrator Shen Tianzi greatly defeated Yao Hong at Lantian.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Fufeng Administrator Shen Tianzi routed Yao Hong at Lantian.

sentences.zh: 王鎮惡剋長安，生擒泓。

translations.literal: Wang Zhen’e took Chang’an and captured Hong alive.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhen’e took Chang’an and captured Hong alive.

sentences.zh: 九月，公至長安。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the Duke reached Chang’an.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Duke reached Chang’an.

sentences.zh: 長安豐全，帑藏盈積。

translations.literal: Chang’an was abundant and complete; the treasury stores were full and piled.
translations.idiomatic: Chang’an was rich and whole; treasuries were full to overflowing.

sentences.zh: 公先收其彝器、渾儀、土圭之屬，獻于京師；

translations.literal: The Duke first collected its ritual vessels, armillary sphere, earth-square, and the like, and presented them to the capital;
translations.idiomatic: The Duke first sent its ritual vessels, armillary sphere, earth-square, and the like to the capital;

sentences.zh: 其餘珍寶珠玉，以班賜將帥。

translations.literal: the remaining precious treasures, pearls, and jade he distributed in reward to generals and commanders.
translations.idiomatic: and distributed the remaining treasures, pearls, and jade among his generals.

sentences.zh: 執送姚泓，斬于建康市。

translations.literal: He escorted and sent Yao Hong, who was beheaded in the market of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Hong was sent to the capital and beheaded in the market at Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 謁漢高帝陵，大會文武於未央殿。

translations.literal: He visited the tomb-mound of Emperor Gao of Han and held a great assembly of civil and military officials in Weiyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He visited the tomb of Emperor Gao of Han and held a great assembly of civil and military officials in Weiyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 十月，天子詔曰：

translations.literal: In the tenth month, the Son of Heaven issued an edict:
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the Son of Heaven issued an edict:

sentences.zh: 朕聞先王之莅天下也，上則大寶以尊德，下則建侯以褒功。

translations.literal: We have heard that when the former kings held the world, above they took the great treasure to honor virtue, below they established feudal lords to reward merit.
translations.idiomatic: We have heard that when the ancient kings ruled the world, above they honored virtue with the great treasure, below they enfeoffed lords to reward merit.

sentences.zh: 是以成勳告就，文命有玄圭之錫，四海來王，姬旦饗龜、蒙之封。

translations.literal: Therefore when the achievement was complete and announced, Wenming had the black jade scepter bestowed; when the four seas came as kings, Ji Dan enjoyed the tortoise and banner enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: When achievement was complete, Yu received the black jade scepter; when the four seas submitted, the Duke of Zhou received the tortoise and banner enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 夫翼聖宣績，輔德弘猷，禮窮元賞，寵章希世。

translations.literal: To wing the sage and proclaim achievement, assist virtue and enlarge the plan—the ritual exhausts the highest reward, and favor-regalia is rare in the age.
translations.idiomatic: To assist the sage and proclaim achievement, to aid virtue and enlarge the design—such merit wins the highest reward and honors rare in any age.

sentences.zh: 況明保沖昧，獨運陶鈞者哉！

translations.literal: How much more when one clearly protects the tender and dim, and alone turns the potters wheel!
translations.idiomatic: How much more when one clearly protects the young ruler and alone turns the potters wheel!

sentences.zh: 朕以不德，遭家多難，雲雷作屯，夷羿竊命，失位京邑，遂播蠻荊，艱難卑約，制命凶醜。

translations.literal: We, with little virtue, encountered many difficulties in Our house; cloud and thunder made difficulty, Yi the Archer stole the mandate; We lost Our place in the capital region and were driven among the southern barbarians; in hardship and low estate We were constrained by the vicious and ugly.
translations.idiomatic: We, lacking virtue, met many troubles in Our house; cloud and thunder brought hardship, and Yi the Archer stole the mandate; We lost the capital and were driven among the southern barbarians; in hardship We were constrained by vicious foes.

sentences.zh: 相國宋公，天縱睿聖，命世應期，誠貫三靈，大節宏發。

translations.literal: Chancellor of State and Duke of Song: Heaven overspreads him with sagely intelligence; he answers the age by mandate; sincerity penetrates the three spirits; great integrity broadly rises.
translations.idiomatic: The Chancellor of State and Duke of Song: Heaven endowed him with sagely intelligence; he answers the age; his sincerity reaches the three spirits; his great integrity rises abroad.

sentences.zh: 拯朕躬於巢幕，迴靈命於已崩，固已道窮北面，暉格八表者矣。

translations.literal: He rescued Our person from the nest and curtain, turned the numinous mandate back from already collapsed—thus his Way has exhausted the north-facing subject, and his radiance grids the eight regions.
translations.idiomatic: He rescued Us from the nest and curtain, restored the mandate from collapse—his Way has gone beyond any north-facing subject, and his radiance covers the eight regions.

sentences.zh: 及外積全國之勳，內累戡黎之伐，芟夷強妖之始，蘊崇姦猾之源，顯仁藏用之道，六府孔修之績，莫不雲行雨施，能事必舉，諒已方軌於三、五，不容於典策者焉。

translations.literal: Moreover, outwardly he accumulated achievement of completing the state, inwardly he piled achievement of pacifying the black-haired people; at the beginning of cutting down the strong demons, at the source of heaping up the crafty and slippery—of the Way of displaying benevolence and concealing use, and the achievement of the six treasuries greatly repaired—none were not cloud-walking and rain-bestowing; able affairs were certainly raised; truly he has already squared his track with the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors, and cannot be contained in canon and statute.
translations.idiomatic: Outwardly he completed the state, inwardly he pacified the people; he cut down mighty foes at the root and cleared treacherous sources; he displayed benevolence and concealed his methods, and repaired the six treasuries—cloud and rain followed his acts; truly he matches the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors and cannot be contained in canon and statute.

sentences.zh: 自永嘉喪師，綿踰十紀，五都分崩，然正朔時暨；

translations.literal: Since the Yongjia loss of the army, more than ten reigns have passed in succession; the five capitals split apart, yet the orthodox calendar still reached in time;
translations.idiomatic: Since the Yongjia disaster more than ten reigns have passed; the five capitals fell apart, yet the orthodox calendar still held;

sentences.zh: 唯三秦懸隔，未之暫賓。

translations.literal: only the three Qins hung apart and for a time were not guests.
translations.idiomatic: only the three Qin hung apart and for a time did not submit.

sentences.zh: 至令羌虜襲亂，淫虐三世，資百二之易守，恃函谷之可關，廟算韜略，不謀之日久矣。

translations.literal: Until now the Qiang barbarians have carried on disorder, licentious and cruel through three reigns; relying on the ease of holding the hundred-and-two, trusting that Hangu Pass could be closed—temple calculation and hidden strategy were not plotted for many days.
translations.idiomatic: Until now the Qiang have carried on disorder, licentious and cruel through three reigns, trusting in the ease of holding the heartland and the strength of Hangu Pass—long had no plan been laid against them.

sentences.zh: 公命世撫運，闡曜威靈，內研諸侯之慮，外致上天之罰。

translations.literal: The Duke, by mandate of the age, calms the turning; he unfolds bright martial spirit, inwardly studies the lords anxieties, outwardly brings down Heavens punishment.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke, born for the age, calms the turning; he unfolds bright martial spirit, studies the lords within, and brings down Heavens punishment without.

sentences.zh: 故能倉兕甫訓，則許、鄭風偃，鉦鉞未指，則瀍、洛霧披。

translations.literal: Therefore when the storehouse rhinoceros had just been instructed, Xu and Zheng bent to the wind; before battle-axes and halberds were pointed, Chan and Luo scattered like mist.
translations.idiomatic: When he first taught discipline, Xu and Zheng bent to the wind; before his axes were pointed, Chan and Luo scattered like mist.

sentences.zh: 俾舊闕之陽，復集萬國之軫，東京父老，重覩司隸之章。

translations.literal: He made the yang of the old breach again gather the axle-pins of ten thousand states; the elders of the eastern capital again beheld the statutes of the Minister of the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: He made the sun of the old capital shine again and gathered the axle-pins of ten thousand states; the elders of the eastern capital again beheld the statutes of the Minister of the Masses.

sentences.zh: 俾朕負扆高拱，而保大洪烈。

translations.literal: He made Us, back to the throne with arms folded high, preserve the great flood of merit.
translations.idiomatic: He made Us, leaning on the throne with folded arms, preserve the great flood of merit.

sentences.zh: 是用遠鑒前典，延即羣謀，敬授殊錫，光啟疆宇。

translations.literal: For this We, looking far to former canon, extended and took counsel of the multitude, respectfully conferred special gifts, and brightly opened the frontier lands.
translations.idiomatic: For this We looked to former canon, took counsel of the multitude, and conferred special gifts to open the frontier.

sentences.zh: 乘馬之制，有陋舊章；

translations.literal: The system of chariots of honor has been narrow compared with old statutes;
translations.idiomatic: The chariots of honor have been narrow compared with old statutes;

sentences.zh: 徽稱之美，未窮上爵。

translations.literal: the beauty of emblematic titles has not exhausted the highest rank.
translations.idiomatic: the beauty of emblematic titles has not reached the highest rank.

sentences.zh: 豈足以顯報懋功，允塞民望；

translations.literal: How could they suffice to display repayment of abundant merit and truly fill the peoples hope;
translations.idiomatic: How could they suffice to repay abundant merit and truly fill the peoples hope;

sentences.zh: 藩輔王畿，長轡六合者乎。

translations.literal: to be screen and assistant to the royal precinct, long reins on the six harmonies?
translations.idiomatic: to be screen and assistant to the throne and hold the long reins of the realm?

sentences.zh: 實以公每秉謙德，卑不可踰，難進之道，以寵為戚。

translations.literal: Truly because the Duke each time holds modest virtue, low and not to be overstepped—the Way hard to advance—We take favor as sorrow.
translations.idiomatic: Truly because the Duke each time holds modest virtue, humble and not to be overstepped—the Way hard to advance—We take favor as sorrow.

sentences.zh: 是故降損盛制，且有後命也。

translations.literal: Therefore We lowered and reduced the grand system, and there was a later mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore We lowered the grand system, and there was a later mandate.

sentences.zh: 自茲迄今，洪勳彌劭，稜威九河，魏、趙底服，迴轅崤、潼，連城冰泮。

translations.literal: From then until now, the great achievement has grown ever stronger; edge and might fill the nine rivers, Wei and Zhao reach the bottom in submission; turning the chariot at Xiao and Tong, linked cities melt like ice.
translations.idiomatic: From then until now his great achievement has grown; his might fills the nine rivers, Wei and Zhao submit at the bottom; turning at Xiao and Tong, linked cities melt like ice.

sentences.zh: 遂長驅灞、滻，懸旍龍門，逆虜姚泓，係頸就擒。

translations.literal: Then he drove far at Ba and Chan, hung his banners at Long Gate; the rebellious captive Yao Hong was bound by the neck and came to capture.
translations.idiomatic: Then he drove far along Ba and Chan, hung his banners at Long Gate; the rebel Yao Hong was bound by the neck and captured.

sentences.zh: 百稔梗穢，滌於崇朝；

translations.literal: A hundred years of obstruction and filth were washed in one morning;
translations.idiomatic: A hundred years of obstruction were washed clean in one morning;

sentences.zh: 祖宗遺憤，雪於一旦。

translations.literal: the ancestors stored wrath was snowed in one day.
translations.idiomatic: the wrath stored by the ancestors was avenged in one day.

sentences.zh: 涉禹之迹，方行天下，至于海外，罔有不服。

translations.literal: He treads the traces of Yu and his square travels the world; reaching to beyond the seas, none do not submit.
translations.idiomatic: He treads the traces of Yu; his rule travels the world; beyond the seas, none do not submit.

sentences.zh: 功固萬世，其寧惟永，豈金石雅頌所能讚揚，實可以告於神明，勒銘嵩、岱者已。

translations.literal: His achievement is solid for ten thousand generations—its tranquillity is everlasting; how could stone, metal, elegant odes, and hymns suffice to praise it? Truly it may be announced to the spirits and carved on Song and Dai.
translations.idiomatic: His achievement will stand for ten thousand generations—everlasting in tranquillity; stone, metal, odes, and hymns cannot praise it enough; truly it may be announced to the spirits and carved on Song and Dai.

sentences.zh: 朕又聞之，周道方遠，則鸑鷟鳴岐，二南播德，則麟騶呈瑞。

translations.literal: We have also heard that when the Zhou Way was just far-reaching, then the zixie bird sang at Qi; when the Two Souths spread virtue, then the qilin and zouyu appeared as omens.
translations.idiomatic: We have also heard that when the Zhou Way was far-reaching, the zixie bird sang at Qi; when the Two Souths spread virtue, qilin and zouyu appeared.

sentences.zh: 自公大號初發，爰暨告成，靈祥炳煥，不可勝紀，豈伊素雉遠至，嘉禾近歸而已哉！

translations.literal: From when the Dukes great title was first raised until the announcement of completion, numinous omens blazed and shone beyond counting—how could it be only the plain pheasant coming from afar and fine grain returning from near!
translations.idiomatic: From when the Dukes great title was first raised until completion, numinous omens blazed beyond counting—far more than plain pheasants from afar and fine grain from near!

sentences.zh: 朕每仰鑒玄應，俯察人謀，進惟道勳，退惟國典，豈得遂公沖挹，而久蘊盛策。

translations.literal: We each time look up to mirror the mysterious response, look down to examine human plans; advancing We consider the Ways achievement, retreating We consider the states canon—how can We follow the Dukes modest restraint and long hoard the grand plan?
translations.idiomatic: We look up to mirror the mysterious response and down to examine human plans; advancing We consider the Ways achievement, retreating the states canon—how can We follow the Dukes modest restraint and long hoard the grand plan?

sentences.zh: 便宜敬行大禮，允副幽顯之望。

translations.literal: It is fitting respectfully to carry out the great rite and truly fulfill the hope of the hidden and manifest.
translations.idiomatic: It is fitting respectfully to carry out the great rite and fulfill the hope of the hidden and manifest.

sentences.zh: 其進宋公爵為王，以徐州之海陵東安北琅邪北東莞北東海北譙北梁、豫州之汝南北潁川北南頓凡十郡，益宋國。

translations.literal: Let him advance from Duke of Song to King, with the ten commanderies Hailing, Dongan, Northern Langye, Northern Dongguan, Northern Donghai, Northern Qiao, and Northern Liang of Xuzhou, and Runan, Northern Yingchuan, and Northern Nandun of Yuzhou, to enlarge the state of Song.
translations.idiomatic: Let him advance from Duke of Song to King, adding ten commanderies—Hailing, Dongan, Northern Langye, Northern Dongguan, Northern Donghai, Northern Qiao, and Northern Liang in Xuzhou, and Runan, Northern Yingchuan, and Northern Nandun in Yuzhou—to enlarge the state of Song.

sentences.zh: 其相國、揚州牧、領征西將軍、司豫北徐雍四州刺史如故。

translations.literal: His Chancellor of State, Governor of Yangzhou, and continuing as Campaigning-west General and Governor of the four provinces Si, Yu, Northern Xu, and Yong are as before.
translations.idiomatic: He remains Chancellor of State, Governor of Yangzhou, Campaigning-west General, and governor of Si, Yu, Northern Xu, and Yong.

sentences.zh: 十一月，前將軍劉穆之卒，以左司馬徐羨之代掌留任。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Forward General Liu Muzhi died; Left Army Marshal Xu Xianzhi was appointed to take over the duties left behind.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Forward General Liu Muzhi died; Left Army Marshal Xu Xianzhi took over the duties left behind.

sentences.zh: 大事昔所決於穆之者，皆悉以諮。

translations.literal: Great affairs that formerly were decided by Muzhi were all alike brought to consultation.
translations.idiomatic: All great affairs formerly decided by Muzhi were alike referred to him for consultation.

sentences.zh: 公欲息駕長安，經略趙、魏，會穆之卒，乃歸。

translations.literal: The Duke wished to halt his chariot at Chang’an and plan strategy for Zhao and Wei; it happened that Muzhi died, and therefore he returned.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke wished to halt at Chang’an and plan for Zhao and Wei; when Muzhi died, he returned.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子，發自長安，以桂陽公義真為安西將軍、雍州刺史，留腹心將佐以輔之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day gengzi, he set out from Chang’an, appointing Prince of Guiyang Yizhen as General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yongzhou, and leaving trusted generals and aides to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day gengzi, he departed Chang’an, made Prince of Guiyang Yizhen General Who Pacifies the West and inspector of Yongzhou, and left trusted officers to assist him.

sentences.zh: 閏月，公自洛入河，開汴渠以歸。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, the Duke entered the river from Luoyang, opened the Bian Canal, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month Gaozu entered the river from Luoyang, opened the Bian Canal, and returned.

sentences.zh: 十四年正月壬戌，公至彭城，解嚴息甲。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourteenth year, on the day renxu, the Duke reached Pengcheng, lifted the martial ban, and rested the armor.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourteenth year, on the day renxu, Gaozu reached Pengcheng, lifted martial law, and stood down the troops.

sentences.zh: 以輔國將軍劉遵考為并州刺史，領河東太守，鎮蒲坂。

translations.literal: Auxiliary State General Liu Zunkao was made Inspector of Bingzhou, concurrently Administrator of Hedong, and stationed at Puban.
translations.idiomatic: Auxiliary State General Liu Zunkao was made inspector of Bingzhou and Hedong administrator, stationed at Puban.

sentences.zh: 公解司州，領徐、冀二州刺史，固讓進爵。

translations.literal: The Duke relinquished Si province, took the two inspectorates of Xu and Ji, and firmly declined advancement in rank.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu relinquished Si province, took Xu and Ji, and firmly declined further honors.

sentences.zh: 六月，受相國宋公九錫之命。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he received the command of the Nine Bestowments as Duke of Song, Chancellor of State.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he received the Nine Bestowments as Duke of Song and Chancellor of State.

sentences.zh: 令曰：「孤以寡薄，負荷殊重，守位奉藩，危溢是懼。

translations.literal: An order said: "I, alone and slight, bear a weight beyond measure; holding my place and serving as a frontier lord, I fear overflow and peril.
translations.idiomatic: An order said: "I, alone and slight, bear a weight beyond measure; holding my place and serving as a frontier lord, I fear overflow and peril.

sentences.zh: 朝恩隆泰，委美推功，遂方軌齊、晉，擬議國典。

translations.literal: The court’s grace is lofty and great; beauty is entrusted and merit pushed forward—thus to match Qi and Jin in measure, and to draft the state canon.
translations.idiomatic: The court’s grace is lofty; merit is pushed forward—thus to match Qi and Jin in measure and draft the state canon.

sentences.zh: 雖亮誠守分，十稔于今，而成命弗迴，百辟胥暨內外庶僚，敦勉周至。

translations.literal: Although I have shown bright sincerity and kept my place, ten years have passed until now, yet the completed mandate will not turn back; the hundred ministers all arrive, inner and outer officials alike, urging with utmost earnestness.
translations.idiomatic: Although I have shown bright sincerity and kept my place these ten years, the mandate will not turn back; ministers and officials inner and outer alike urge with utmost earnestness.

sentences.zh: 籍運來之功，參休明之迹，乘菲薄之資，同盛德之事，監寐永言，未知攸託。

translations.literal: Relying on the merit that came with the age, sharing in the traces of enlightened rule, riding slight and thin resources, joining in affairs of great virtue—I watch and wake and speak forever, not knowing where to lodge my trust.
translations.idiomatic: Relying on the merit of the age and sharing in enlightened rule, with slight resources joining great affairs—I wake and brood, not knowing where to lodge my trust.

sentences.zh: 隆祚之始，思覃斯慶。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the exalted reign, I think to spread this celebration.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the exalted reign, I think to spread this celebration.

sentences.zh: 其赦國內殊死以下，今月二十三日昧爽以前，悉皆原宥。

translations.literal: Let all within the state below the death penalty be pardoned, before dawn on the twenty-third of this month—all alike forgiven.
translations.idiomatic: Let all within the state below the death penalty be pardoned before dawn on the twenty-third of this month—all alike forgiven.

sentences.zh: 鰥寡孤獨不能自存者，人賜粟五斛。

translations.literal: Widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary who cannot support themselves—each is granted five hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: Widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary who cannot support themselves shall each receive five hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 府州刑罪，亦同蕩然。

translations.literal: Criminal cases in the prefectures and commanderies are likewise swept clean.
translations.idiomatic: Criminal cases in the prefectures and commanderies are likewise swept clean.

sentences.zh: 其餘詳依舊準。

translations.literal: The rest shall follow the old standards in detail.
translations.idiomatic: The rest shall follow the old standards in detail.

sentences.zh: 」詔崇豫章公太夫人為宋公太妃，世子中軍將軍，副貳相國府。

translations.literal: An edict honored the Grand Lady of Yuzhang, mother of the Duke of Song, as Grand Consort of the Duke of Song; the heir was made Central Army General and deputy to the Chancellor of State’s office.
translations.idiomatic: An edict honored the Grand Lady of Yuzhang, mother of the Duke of Song, as Grand Consort of the Duke of Song; the heir was made Central Army General and deputy to the Chancellor of State’s office.

sentences.zh: 以太尉軍諮祭酒孔季恭為宋國尚書令，青州刺史檀祗為領軍將軍，相國左長史王弘為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: Grand Commandant Army Consultation Sacrifice-officer Kong Jigong was made Song State Master of Writing Director; Inspector of Qingzhou Tan Zhi was made Commanding General; the Chancellor of State’s Left Chief Clerk Wang Hong was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Jigong, Grand Commandant army consultation sacrifice-officer, was made Song State Master of Writing Director; Qingzhou inspector Tan Zhi was made Commanding General; Chancellor of State left chief clerk Wang Hong was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 其餘百官悉依天朝之制。

translations.literal: The rest of the hundred officials all followed the Heavenly Court’s system.
translations.idiomatic: The rest of the hundred officials all followed the imperial court’s system.

sentences.zh: 又詔宋國所封十郡之外，悉得除用。

translations.literal: An edict further said that beyond the ten commanderies enfeoffed to the Song State, appointments might be made at will.
translations.idiomatic: An edict further said that beyond the ten commanderies enfeoffed to the Song State, appointments might be made at will.

sentences.zh: 先是安西中兵參軍沈田子殺安西司馬王鎮惡，諸將軍復殺安西長史王脩。

translations.literal: Earlier, Pacifying-the-West Central Army Major Shen Tianzi had killed Pacifying-the-West Major Wang Zhen’e; the generals in turn killed Pacifying-the-West Chief Clerk Wang Xiu.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Pacifying-the-West central army major Shen Tianzi killed Pacifying-the-West major Wang Zhen’e; the generals in turn killed Pacifying-the-West chief clerk Wang Xiu.

sentences.zh: 關中亂。

translations.literal: Guanzhong fell into chaos.
translations.idiomatic: Guanzhong fell into chaos.

sentences.zh: 十月，公遣右將軍朱齡石代安西將軍桂陽公義真為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the Duke sent Right General Zhu Lingshi to replace Pacifying-the-West General Prince of Guiyang Yizhen as Inspector of Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Gaozu sent Right General Zhu Lingshi to replace Pacifying-the-West General Prince of Guiyang Yizhen as inspector of Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 義真既還，為佛佛虜所追，大敗，僅以身免。

translations.literal: When Yizhen had returned, the Fofo barbarians pursued him; he was greatly defeated and barely escaped with his life.
translations.idiomatic: When Yizhen had returned, the Fofo barbarians pursued him; he was routed and barely escaped with his life.

sentences.zh: 諸將帥及齡石並沒。

translations.literal: The generals and Zhu Lingshi were all lost.
translations.idiomatic: The generals and Zhu Lingshi were all lost.

sentences.zh: 領軍檀祗卒，以中軍司馬檀道濟為中領軍。

translations.literal: Commanding General Tan Zhi died; Central Army Major Tan Daoji was made Central Commanding General.
translations.idiomatic: Commanding General Tan Zhi died; Central Army Major Tan Daoji was made Central Commanding General.

sentences.zh: 十二月，天子崩，大司馬琅邪王即帝位。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the Son of Heaven died; the Grand Marshal, Prince of Langye, took the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the emperor died; Grand Marshal Prince of Langye took the throne.

sentences.zh: 十二月，天子命王冕十有二旒，建天子旌旗，出警入蹕，乘金根車，駕六馬，備五時副車，置旄頭雲罕，樂舞八佾，設鍾虡宮縣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the Son of Heaven ordered the kingly crown of twelve tassels, the establishment of the Son of Heaven’s banners, going out with imperial guard and entering with clearance, riding the golden-root carriage, driving six horses, with five-season secondary carriages prepared, setting maotou and yunhan, music and dance of eight rows, and suspended bells and palace music established.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the emperor ordered the kingly crown of twelve tassels, imperial banners, imperial guard on going out and clearance on entering, the golden-root carriage with six horses, five-season secondary carriages, maotou and yunhan insignia, eight-row music and dance, and suspended bells and palace music.

sentences.zh: 進王太妃為太后，王妃為王后，世子為太子，王子、王孫爵命之號，一如舊儀。

translations.literal: The kingly grand consort was advanced to Empress Dowager, the kingly consort to Queen, the heir to Crown Prince; princes and royal grandsons—titles and commands all followed the old rites.
translations.idiomatic: The kingly grand consort was advanced to Empress Dowager, the kingly consort to Queen, the heir to Crown Prince; princes and royal grandsons received titles and commands as in the old rites.

sentences.zh: 二年四月，徵王入輔。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year, the king was summoned to assist at court.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year the king was summoned to assist at court.

sentences.zh: 六月，至京師。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he reached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 晉帝禪位于王，詔曰：

translations.literal: The Jin emperor abdicated the throne to the king; an edict said:
translations.idiomatic: The Jin emperor abdicated the throne to the king; an edict said:

sentences.zh: 夫天造草昧，樹之司牧，所以陶鈞三極，統天施化。

translations.literal: Heaven in its making left the world in obscurity and set up shepherds of the people, thereby to mold the three poles, unify Heaven, and dispense transformation.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven in its making left the world in obscurity and set up shepherds of the people, thereby to mold the three poles, unify Heaven, and dispense transformation.

sentences.zh: 故大道之行，選賢與能，隆替無常期，禪代非一族，貫之百王，由來尚矣。

translations.literal: Therefore when the Great Way prevailed, the worthy and able were chosen; rise and fall had no fixed term, abdication and succession belonged to no single clan—threaded through the hundred kings, honored from of old.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore when the Great Way prevailed, the worthy and able were chosen; rise and fall had no fixed term, abdication and succession belonged to no single clan—threaded through the hundred kings, honored from of old.

sentences.zh: 晉道陵遲，仍世多故，爰暨元興，禍難既積，至三光貿位，冠履易所，安皇播越，宗祀墮泯，則我宣、元之祚，永墜于地，顧瞻區域，翦焉已傾。

translations.literal: The Jin Way declined and waned; generation after generation knew many troubles; reaching Yuankang, calamities piled up; the three luminaries changed place, crown and shoes exchanged stations; Emperor An was driven abroad, the ancestral sacrifices fell and perished—then the fortunes of Xuan and Yuan forever fell to earth; looking over the realm, it was already cut down and toppled.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin Way declined; generation after generation knew troubles; reaching Yuankang calamities piled up; the three luminaries changed place; Emperor An was driven abroad and ancestral sacrifices perished—the fortunes of Xuan and Yuan fell forever; looking over the realm, it was cut down and toppled.

sentences.zh: 相國宋王，天縱聖德，靈武秀世，一匡頹運，再造區夏，固以興滅繼絕，舟航淪溺矣。

translations.literal: Chancellor Song King—Heaven-sent in sage virtue, numinous martial excellence towering in the age—once righted the tottering age and twice remade the Central Realm; truly he raised the fallen and continued the cut off, a boat and raft for the drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Song King—Heaven-sent in sage virtue, numinous martial excellence towering in the age—once righted the tottering age and twice remade the Central Realm; truly he raised the fallen and continued the cut off, a boat and raft for the drowned.

sentences.zh: 若夫仰在璿璣，旁穆七政，薄伐不庭，開復疆宇。

translations.literal: As for looking up to the celestial pearl and harmonizing the seven regulators, punishing the unsubmissive and reopening the frontiers—
translations.idiomatic: As for looking up to the celestial pearl and harmonizing the seven regulators, punishing the unsubmissive and reopening the frontiers—

sentences.zh: 遂乃三俘偽主，開滌五都，雕顏卉服之鄉，龍荒朔漠之長，莫不迴首朝陽，沐浴玄澤。

translations.literal: then thrice capturing false rulers, cleansing the five capitals, lands of tattooed faces and flowery dress, the long reaches of the dragon wilderness and northern desert—all alike turned their heads to the rising sun and bathed in the dark beneficence.
translations.idiomatic: then thrice capturing false rulers, cleansing the five capitals; lands of tattooed faces and flowery dress, the long reaches of the dragon wilderness and northern desert—all turned to the rising sun and bathed in dark beneficence.

sentences.zh: 故四靈効瑞，川岳啟圖，嘉祥雜遝，休應炳著，玄象表革命之期，華裔注樂推之願。

translations.literal: Therefore the four numina sent auspicious signs, rivers and mountains opened their charts, good omens piled in abundance, blessed responses blazed forth; the dark signs showed the term of revolution, Chinese and barbarian recorded the wish for joyful elevation.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the four numina sent auspicious signs, rivers and mountains opened their charts, good omens piled in abundance, blessed responses blazed forth; the dark signs showed the term of revolution, Chinese and barbarian recorded the wish for joyful elevation.

sentences.zh: 代德之符，著乎幽顯，瞻烏爰止，允集明哲，夫豈延康有歸，咸熙告謝而已哉！

translations.literal: The token of the replacing virtue was manifest in the hidden and manifest; looking to the crow that alights, the wise truly gather—how could it be only that Yancong had its return and Xianxi announced its farewell!
translations.idiomatic: The token of the replacing virtue was manifest in the hidden and manifest; looking to the crow that alights, the wise truly gather—how could it be only that Yancong had its return and Xianxi announced its farewell!

sentences.zh: 昔火德既微，魏祖底績，黃運不競，三后肆勤。

translations.literal: Formerly when the Fire Virtue had waned, the Wei ancestor laid the foundation; the Yellow Fortune did not prevail, and the three sovereigns toiled with diligence.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly when the Fire Virtue had waned, the Wei ancestor laid the foundation; the Yellow Fortune did not prevail, and the three sovereigns toiled with diligence.

sentences.zh: 故天之曆數，實有攸在。

translations.literal: Therefore Heaven’s calendar and number truly had their place.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore Heaven’s calendar and number truly had their place.

sentences.zh: 朕雖庸闇，昧於大道，永鑒廢興，為日已久。

translations.literal: We, though dull and dark, are obscure to the Great Way; forever mirroring rise and fall has been so for long days.
translations.idiomatic: We, though dull and dark, are obscure to the Great Way; forever mirroring rise and fall has been so for long days.

sentences.zh: 念四代之高義，稽天人之至望，予其遜位別宮，歸禪于宋，一依唐虞、漢魏故事。

translations.literal: Reflecting on the lofty righteousness of the four generations and examining the utmost hope of Heaven and man, We shall yield the throne to a separate palace and abdicate to Song, all according to the precedents of Tang and Yu, Han and Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Reflecting on the lofty righteousness of the four generations and examining the utmost hope of Heaven and man, We shall yield the throne to a separate palace and abdicate to Song, all according to the precedents of Tang and Yu, Han and Wei.

sentences.zh: 詔草既成，送呈天子使書之，天子即便操筆，謂左右曰：「桓玄之時，天命已改，重為劉公所延，將二十載。

translations.literal: When the edict draft was complete, it was sent and presented to the Son of Heaven for him to write it; the Son of Heaven at once took up the brush and said to those at his side: "In Huan Xuan’s time Heaven’s mandate had already changed; it was again extended by Duke Liu for nearly twenty years.
translations.idiomatic: When the edict draft was complete, it was sent for the emperor to write; the emperor at once took up the brush and said to those at his side: "In Huan Xuan’s time Heaven’s mandate had already changed; it was again extended by Duke Liu for nearly twenty years.

sentences.zh: 今日之事，本所甘心。

translations.literal: Today’s affair is what I gladly accept at heart.
translations.idiomatic: Today’s affair is what I gladly accept at heart.

sentences.zh: 」甲子，策曰：

translations.literal: On the day jiazi the written mandate said:
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi the written mandate said:

sentences.zh: 咨爾宋王：夫玄古權輿，悠哉邈矣，其詳靡得而聞。

translations.literal: Consult you, Song King: In remote antiquity authority first arose—long ago and far away; the details cannot be heard.
translations.idiomatic: Consult you, Song King: In remote antiquity authority first arose—long ago and far away; the details cannot be heard.

sentences.zh: 爰自書契，降逮三、五，莫不以上聖君四海，止戈定大業。

translations.literal: From when writing and tallies began, down to the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors, none failed to use the supreme sage to rule the four seas, halt the weapons, and settle the great enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: From when writing and tallies began, down to the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors, none failed to use the supreme sage to rule the four seas, halt the weapons, and settle the great enterprise.

sentences.zh: 然則帝王者，宰物之通器；

translations.literal: Thus the emperor-king is the common vessel for governing things;
translations.idiomatic: Thus the emperor-king is the common vessel for governing things;

sentences.zh: 君道者，天下之至公。

translations.literal: the Way of the ruler is the utmost publicness under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: the Way of the ruler is the utmost publicness under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 昔在上葉，深鑒茲道，是以天祿既終，唐、虞弗得傳其嗣；

translations.literal: Formerly in the upper age, deeply mirroring this Way, therefore when Heaven’s emolument had ended, Tang and Yu could not pass their succession to their heirs;
translations.idiomatic: Formerly in the upper age, deeply mirroring this Way, therefore when Heaven’s emolument had ended, Tang and Yu could not pass their succession to their heirs;

sentences.zh: 符命來格，舜、禹不獲全其謙。

translations.literal: when the token-mandate came down, Shun and Yu could not fully keep their modesty.
translations.idiomatic: when the token-mandate came down, Shun and Yu could not fully keep their modesty.

sentences.zh: 所以經緯三才，澄序彝化，作範振古，垂風萬葉，莫尚於茲。

translations.literal: Therefore to weave the three talents, clarify and order constant transformation, make a model to shake antiquity, and hang wind for ten thousand generations—nothing is greater than this.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore to weave the three talents, clarify and order constant transformation, make a model to shake antiquity, and hang wind for ten thousand generations—nothing is greater than this.

sentences.zh: 自是厥後，歷代彌劭，漢既嗣德於放勛，魏亦方軌於重華。

translations.literal: From then onward the generations grew ever stronger; Han succeeded the virtue of Fangxun, and Wei likewise matched Chonghua in measure.
translations.idiomatic: From then onward the generations grew ever stronger; Han succeeded the virtue of Fangxun, and Wei likewise matched Chonghua in measure.

sentences.zh: 諒以協謀乎人鬼，而以百姓為心者也。

translations.literal: Truly they coordinated counsel between men and ghosts, and took the hundred surnames as their heart.
translations.idiomatic: Truly they coordinated counsel between men and ghosts, and took the hundred surnames as their heart.

sentences.zh: 昔我祖宗欽明，辰居其極，而明晦代序，盈虧有期。

translations.literal: Formerly our ancestors were reverent and bright, the celestial seat at the pole; yet brightness and darkness succeeded in order, waxing and waning had their term.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly our ancestors were reverent and bright, the celestial seat at the pole; yet brightness and darkness succeeded in order, waxing and waning had their term.

sentences.zh: 翦商兆禍，非唯一世，曾是弗剋，矧伊在今，天之所廢，有自來矣。

translations.literal: Cutting Shang foretold calamity—not for one generation alone; once this could not be overcome—how much more today; what Heaven abandons has come from of old.
translations.idiomatic: Cutting Shang foretold calamity—not for one generation alone; once this could not be overcome—how much more today; what Heaven abandons has come from of old.

sentences.zh: 惟王體上聖之姿，苞二儀之德，明齊日月，道合四時。

translations.literal: Only the king embodies the posture of the supreme sage, embraces the virtue of the two principles, brightness equal to sun and moon, Way matching the four seasons.
translations.idiomatic: Only the king embodies the posture of the supreme sage, embraces the virtue of the two principles, brightness equal to sun and moon, Way matching the four seasons.

sentences.zh: 乃者社稷傾覆，王拯而存之，中原蕪梗，又濟而復之。
