translations.literal: Recently when the altars of soil and grain toppled, the king rescued and preserved them; when the Central Plain lay waste and choked with brambles, he again crossed and restored it.
translations.idiomatic: Recently when the altars of soil and grain toppled, the king rescued and preserved them; when the Central Plain lay waste and choked with brambles, he again crossed and restored it.

sentences.zh: 自負固不賓，干紀放命，肆逆滔天，竊據萬里。

translations.literal: From those who relied on their strongholds and would not submit, who violated the statutes and defied mandate, who rebelled excessively to Heaven and secretly seized ten thousand li—
translations.idiomatic: From those who relied on their strongholds and would not submit, who violated the statutes and defied mandate, who rebelled excessively to Heaven and secretly seized ten thousand li—

sentences.zh: 靡不潤之以風雨，震之以雷霆。

translations.literal: none failed to be moistened with wind and rain, shaken with thunder and lightning.
translations.idiomatic: none failed to be moistened with wind and rain, shaken with thunder and lightning.

sentences.zh: 九伐之道既敷，八法之化自理。

translations.literal: The Way of the nine punitive campaigns was already spread; the transformation of the eight laws was naturally ordered.
translations.idiomatic: The Way of the nine punitive campaigns was already spread; the transformation of the eight laws was naturally ordered.

sentences.zh: 豈伊博施於民，濟斯黔庶；

translations.literal: How could it be only that he broadly bestowed on the people and aided this black-haired multitude;
translations.idiomatic: How could it be only that he broadly bestowed on the people and aided this black-haired multitude;

sentences.zh: 固以義洽四海，道威八荒者矣。

translations.literal: truly righteousness harmonized the four seas and the Way awed the eight wilds.
translations.idiomatic: truly righteousness harmonized the four seas and the Way awed the eight wilds.

sentences.zh: 至於上天垂象，四靈效徵，圖讖之文既明，人神之望已改。

translations.literal: As for Heaven above sending down signs, the four numina sending tokens, the texts of charts and prophecies already clear, and the hope of men and spirits already changed—
translations.idiomatic: As for Heaven above sending down signs, the four numina sending tokens, the texts of charts and prophecies already clear, and the hope of men and spirits already changed—

sentences.zh: 百工歌於朝，庶民頌于野，億兆抃踊，傾佇惟新。

translations.literal: the hundred craftsmen sang in court, the common people praised in the wild, the hundred millions clapped and leaped, all inclining and waiting for renewal.
translations.idiomatic: the hundred craftsmen sang in court, the common people praised in the wild, the hundred millions clapped and leaped, all inclining and waiting for renewal.

sentences.zh: 自非百姓樂推，天命攸集，豈伊在予，所得獨專。

translations.literal: If not that the hundred surnames joyfully elevated him, and Heaven’s mandate gathered there, how could it be in Us alone that it could be exclusively held?
translations.idiomatic: If not that the hundred surnames joyfully elevated him, and Heaven’s mandate gathered there, how could it be in Us alone that it could be exclusively held?

sentences.zh: 是用仰祗皇靈，俯順羣議，敬禪神器，授帝位于爾躬。

translations.literal: For this We look up and revere the imperial numen, look down and follow the multitude’s counsel, reverently abdicate the divine vessel, and confer the imperial position on your person.
translations.idiomatic: For this We look up and revere the imperial numen, look down and follow the multitude’s counsel, reverently abdicate the divine vessel, and confer the imperial position on your person.

sentences.zh: 大祚告窮，天祿永終。

translations.literal: The great fortune is declared exhausted; Heaven’s emolument forever ended.
translations.idiomatic: The great fortune is declared exhausted; Heaven’s emolument forever ended.

sentences.zh: 於戲！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 王其允執其中，敬遵典訓，副率土之嘉願，恢洪業於無窮，時膺休祐，以答三靈之眷望。

translations.literal: King, truly hold the center, reverently follow the canonical instructions, fulfill the good wish of all within the realm, expand the grand enterprise without end, timely receive blessed protection, and answer the loving hope of the three numina.
translations.idiomatic: King, truly hold the center, reverently follow the canonical instructions, fulfill the good wish of all within the realm, expand the grand enterprise without end, timely receive blessed protection, and answer the loving hope of the three numina.

sentences.zh: 又璽書曰：

translations.literal: An imperial letter further said:
translations.idiomatic: An imperial letter further said:

sentences.zh: 蓋聞天生蒸民，樹之以君，帝皇寄世，實公四海，崇替係於勳德，升降存乎其人。

translations.literal: We have heard that Heaven born the teeming people and set up rulers for them; emperors and kings entrusted to the age truly shared the four seas; rise and fall depended on merit and virtue, ascent and descent rested on the man.
translations.idiomatic: We have heard that Heaven born the teeming people and set up rulers for them; emperors and kings entrusted to the age truly shared the four seas; rise and fall depended on merit and virtue, ascent and descent rested on the man.

sentences.zh: 故有國必亡，卜年著其數，代謝無常，聖哲握其符。

translations.literal: Therefore having a state must perish; the years of divination show its number; succession is without constancy; the sage and wise grasp its token.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore having a state must perish; the years of divination show its number; succession is without constancy; the sage and wise grasp its token.

sentences.zh: 昔在上世，三聖係軌，疇咨四嶽，以弘揖讓。

translations.literal: Formerly in the upper age the three sages followed in track, consulted the Four Peaks, and thereby enlarged abdication and yielding.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly in the upper age the three sages followed in track, consulted the Four Peaks, and thereby enlarged abdication and yielding.

sentences.zh: 惟先王之有作，永垂範於無窮。

translations.literal: Only what the former kings accomplished hangs as a model forever without end.
translations.idiomatic: Only what the former kings accomplished hangs as a model forever without end.

sentences.zh: 及劉氏致禪，實堯是法，有魏告終，亦憲茲典。

translations.literal: When the Liu house abdicated, it truly took Yao as its model; when Wei announced its end, it likewise took this canon as its law.
translations.idiomatic: When the Liu house abdicated, it truly took Yao as its model; when Wei announced its end, it likewise took this canon as its law.

sentences.zh: 我世祖所以撫歸運而順人事，乘利見而定天保者也。

translations.literal: Our founding emperor therefore soothed the returning fortune and followed human affairs, riding the favorable sign to fix Heaven’s protection.
translations.idiomatic: Our founding emperor therefore soothed the returning fortune and followed human affairs, riding the favorable sign to fix Heaven’s protection.

sentences.zh: 而道不常泰，戎夷亂華，喪我洛食，蹙國江表，仍遘否運，淪沒相因。

translations.literal: Yet the Way was not always at peace; Rong and Yi disturbed Hua; We lost our Luoyang sustenance, the state was cramped south of the river, and still met ill fortune; ruin and submersion followed one upon another.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Way was not always at peace; Rong and Yi disturbed Hua; We lost our Luoyang sustenance, the state was cramped south of the river, and still met ill fortune; ruin and submersion followed one upon another.

sentences.zh: 逮于元興，遂傾宗祀。

translations.literal: Reaching Yuankang, the ancestral sacrifices then toppled.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Yuankang, the ancestral sacrifices then toppled.

sentences.zh: 幸賴神武光天，大節宏發，匡復我社稷，重造我國家。

translations.literal: Fortunately relying on divine martial brilliance that illumined Heaven, great integrity broadly burst forth, We restored our altars of soil and grain and remade our state and family.
translations.idiomatic: Fortunately relying on divine martial brilliance that illumined Heaven, great integrity broadly burst forth, We restored our altars of soil and grain and remade our state and family.

sentences.zh: 惟王聖德欽明，則天光大，應期誕載，明保王室。

translations.literal: Only the king’s sage virtue is reverent and bright, mirrors Heaven’s great light, responded to the term and was born to bear it, clearly protecting the royal house.
translations.idiomatic: Only the king’s sage virtue is reverent and bright, mirrors Heaven’s great light, responded to the term and was born to bear it, clearly protecting the royal house.

sentences.zh: 內紓國難，外播宏略，誅太憝於漢陽，逋僭盜於沂渚，澄氛西岷，肅清南越，再靜江、湘，拓定樊、沔。

translations.literal: Within he eased the state’s peril; without he spread the grand design; at Hanyang he executed the great villain; at Yizhu he drove off the usurping thief; he cleared the miasma at Western Min, solemnly cleansed Southern Yue, twice pacified Jiang and Xiang, and opened and fixed Fan and Mian.
translations.idiomatic: Within he eased the state’s peril; without he spread the grand design; at Hanyang he executed the great villain; at Yizhu he drove off the usurping thief; he cleared the miasma at Western Min, solemnly cleansed Southern Yue, twice pacified Jiang and Xiang, and opened and fixed Fan and Mian.

sentences.zh: 若乃永懷區宇，思一聲教，王師首路，則伊、洛澄流，稜威崤、潼，則華嶽褰靄，偽酋銜璧，咸陽即序。

translations.literal: As for forever cherishing the realm, thinking to unify sound teaching—when the royal army took the first road, then Yi and Luo ran clear; when awe reached Xia and Tong, then Mount Hua lifted its mist; false chiefs held jade and bi, and Xianyang was at once ordered.
translations.idiomatic: As for forever cherishing the realm, thinking to unify sound teaching—when the royal army took the first road, then Yi and Luo ran clear; when awe reached Xia and Tong, then Mount Hua lifted its mist; false chiefs held jade and bi, and Xianyang was at once ordered.

sentences.zh: 雖彝器所銘，詩書所詠，庸勳之盛，莫之與二也。

translations.literal: Although ritual vessels are inscribed and the Odes and Documents are sung, the splendor of ordinary merit—none compares with this.
translations.idiomatic: Although ritual vessels are inscribed and the Odes and Documents are sung, the splendor of ordinary merit—none compares with this.

sentences.zh: 遂偃武修文，誕敷德政，八統以馭萬民，九職以刑邦國，思兼三王，以施四事。

translations.literal: Then he halted weapons and cultivated letters, broadly spread virtuous government, used the eight threads to govern the ten thousand people and the nine offices to rule the state and land, thinking to combine the Three Kings and apply the four affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Then he halted weapons and cultivated letters, broadly spread virtuous government, used the eight threads to govern the ten thousand people and the nine offices to rule the state and land, thinking to combine the Three Kings and apply the four affairs.

sentences.zh: 故能信著幽顯，義感殊方。

translations.literal: Therefore trust was manifest in the hidden and manifest, and righteousness moved distant regions.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore trust was manifest in the hidden and manifest, and righteousness moved distant regions.

sentences.zh: 自歷世所賓，舟車所暨，靡不謳歌仁德，抃舞來庭。

translations.literal: From ages that came as guests to where boats and chariots reached, none failed to sing of benevolent virtue and clap in dance as they came to court.
translations.idiomatic: From ages that came as guests to where boats and chariots reached, none failed to sing of benevolent virtue and clap in dance as they came to court.

sentences.zh: 朕每敬惟道勳，永察符運，天之曆數，實在爾躬。

translations.literal: We each time reverently reflect on the Way’s merit, forever examine the token-fortune; Heaven’s calendar and number truly rest on your person.
translations.idiomatic: We each time reverently reflect on the Way’s merit, forever examine the token-fortune; Heaven’s calendar and number truly rest on your person.

sentences.zh: 是以五緯升度，屢示除舊之迹；

translations.literal: For this the five cords rose in degree, repeatedly showing traces of removing the old;
translations.idiomatic: For this the five cords rose in degree, repeatedly showing traces of removing the old;

sentences.zh: 三光協數，必昭布新之祥。

translations.literal: the three luminaries harmonized in number, surely declaring the auspice of spreading the new.
translations.idiomatic: the three luminaries harmonized in number, surely declaring the auspice of spreading the new.

sentences.zh: 圖讖禎瑞，皎然斯在。

translations.literal: Charts, prophecies, and blessed omens—bright and clear, they are here.
translations.idiomatic: Charts, prophecies, and blessed omens—bright and clear, they are here.

sentences.zh: 加以龍顏英特，天授殊姿，君人之表，煥如日月。

translations.literal: Added to this, dragon countenance outstanding, Heaven-bestowed special posture—the outward form of one who rules men, blazing like sun and moon.
translations.idiomatic: Added to this, dragon countenance outstanding, Heaven-bestowed special posture—the outward form of one who rules men, blazing like sun and moon.

sentences.zh: 傳稱「惟天為大，惟堯則之」。

translations.literal: The Documents say, "Only Heaven is great; only Yao matched it."
translations.idiomatic: The Documents say, "Only Heaven is great; only Yao matched it."

sentences.zh: 詩云：「有命自天，命此文王。

translations.literal: The Odes say: "There is a mandate from Heaven; it commands this King Wen.
translations.idiomatic: The Odes say: "There is a mandate from Heaven; it commands this King Wen.

sentences.zh: 」夫「或躍在淵」者，終饗九五之位；

translations.literal: " For "perhaps leaping in the deep," in the end he enjoys the position of nine and five;
translations.idiomatic: For "perhaps leaping in the deep," in the end he enjoys the position of nine and five;

sentences.zh: 「勳格天地」者，必膺大寶之業。

translations.literal: "Merit reaching Heaven and Earth"—such a one must receive the great treasure’s enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: "Merit reaching Heaven and Earth"—such a one must receive the great treasure’s enterprise.

sentences.zh: 昔土德告沴，傳祚于我有晉；

translations.literal: Formerly when Earth Virtue announced its baleful sign, the succession passed to Our Jin;
translations.idiomatic: Formerly when Earth Virtue announced its baleful sign, the succession passed to Our Jin;

sentences.zh: 今曆運改卜，永終于茲，亦以金德而傳于宋。

translations.literal: Now the calendar-fortune has changed its divination and forever ends here; likewise by Metal Virtue it passes to Song.
translations.idiomatic: Now the calendar-fortune has changed its divination and forever ends here; likewise by Metal Virtue it passes to Song.

sentences.zh: 仰四代之休義，鑒明昏之定期，詢于羣公，爰逮庶尹，咸曰休哉，罔違朕志。

translations.literal: Looking up to the blessed righteousness of the four generations, mirroring the fixed term of brightness and darkness, consulting the multitude of dukes, reaching even to the many directors—all said, "Excellent!" None went against Our intent.
translations.idiomatic: Looking up to the blessed righteousness of the four generations, mirroring the fixed term of brightness and darkness, consulting the multitude of dukes, reaching even to the many directors—all said, "Excellent!" None went against Our intent.

sentences.zh: 今遣使持節、兼太保、散騎常侍、光祿大夫澹，兼太尉、尚書宣範奉皇帝璽綬，受終之禮，一如唐虞、漢魏故事。

translations.literal: Now We send the Bearer of the Staff, concurrently Grand Tutor, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, and Grand Master of Splendid Affairs Tan, together with the Grand Commandant and Master of Writing Xuan Fan, to present the imperial seal and cord and perform the ceremony of receiving the mandate, all according to the precedents of Yao and Shun and of Han and Wei.
translations.idiomatic: We now send Tan, Bearer of the Staff, Grand Tutor, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, and Grand Master of Splendid Affairs, together with Grand Commandant Xuan Fan of the Masters of Writing, to present the imperial seal and cord and perform the transfer of the mandate, as in the precedents of Yao, Shun, Han, and Wei.

sentences.zh: 王其允答人神，君臨萬國，時膺靈祉，酬于上天之眷命。

translations.literal: O King, respond to the hopes of men and spirits, rule the myriad states, receive timely numinous blessing, and answer the favoring mandate of High Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: O King, answer the call of Heaven and men, rule the myriad realms, receive Heaven's blessing in its season, and fulfill the mandate Heaven has granted you.

sentences.zh: 王奉表陳讓，晉帝已遜琅邪王第，表不獲通。

translations.literal: The King submitted a memorial declining; the Jin emperor had already retired to the residence of the Prince of Langye, and the memorial could not be delivered.
translations.idiomatic: The king memorialized his refusal; the Jin emperor had already retired to the Prince of Langye's residence, and the memorial could not reach him.

sentences.zh: 於是陳留王虔嗣等二百七十人，及宋臺羣臣，並上表勸進。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Prince of Chenliu Qian Si and two hundred seventy others, together with the Song court ministers, all submitted memorials urging him to ascend.
translations.idiomatic: Then Prince of Chenliu Qian Si and two hundred seventy others, with the ministers of the Song court, all memorialized urging him to take the throne.

sentences.zh: 上猶不許。

translations.literal: He still would not consent.
translations.idiomatic: He still refused.

sentences.zh: 太史令駱達陳天文符瑞數十條，羣臣又固請，王乃從之。

translations.literal: The Director of the Astronomy Bureau Luo Da presented several dozen items of celestial signs and portents; the ministers again pressed firmly, and the King at last assented.
translations.idiomatic: Astronomy Director Luo Da presented dozens of celestial omens; the ministers pressed again, and the king at last agreed.

sentences.zh: 校勘記

translations.literal: Collation Notes
translations.idiomatic: Textual Collation Notes

sentences.zh: 未能菲躬儉 嚴可均云：「儉下疑奪一字。

translations.literal: Unable to practice frugality in person—Yan Kejun says: "Below jian (frugality) one character was probably lost."
translations.idiomatic: Unable to practice frugality in person—Yan Kejun notes: "A character is probably missing below jian (frugality)."

sentences.zh: 」殿本考證云：「躬下當有節字。

translations.literal: " The Palace Edition collation says: "Below gong (body) there should be the character jie (restraint)."
translations.idiomatic: " The Palace Edition collation says: "Below gong (body) the character jie (restraint) should be read."

sentences.zh: 或儉下脫一用字。」

translations.literal: Or below jian (frugality) the character yong (use) was lost."
translations.idiomatic: Or the character yong (use) was lost below jian (frugality)."

sentences.zh: 公乃進督 「乃」南史作「仍」。

translations.literal: The Duke then advanced in overall supervision—"then" in the History of the Southern Dynasties reads "still."
translations.idiomatic: The Duke then advanced in overall supervision—"then" (nai) in the Nan shi reads "still" (reng).

sentences.zh: 乃速申於當年 「申」各本並譌「由」，據建康實錄、元龜四八六改。

translations.literal: Then quickly reported it in that year—"reported" (shen) in all editions is erroneously written "from" (you); corrected according to the Veritable Records of Jiankang and the Yuan gui 486.
translations.idiomatic: Then quickly reported it in that year—"reported" (shen) is wrongly written "from" (you) in all editions; corrected per the Veritable Records of Jiankang and Yuan gui 486.

sentences.zh: 復加黃鉞 錢大昕廿二史考異云：「加當作假。

translations.literal: Again given the yellow battle-axe—Qian Daxin in his Notes on the Twenty-two Histories says: "Jia (given) should read jia (borrowed).
translations.idiomatic: Again given the yellow battle-axe—Qian Daxin notes: "Given (jia) should read borrowed (jia).

sentences.zh: 使持節得殺二千石以下，假黃鉞則可專戮節將矣。」

translations.literal: The Bearer of the Staff may execute those below two thousand piculs; with a borrowed yellow battle-axe one may exclusively execute commanders bearing credentials."
translations.idiomatic: The Bearer of the Staff may execute officials below two thousand piculs; with a borrowed yellow battle-axe one may execute generals holding credentials."

sentences.zh: 卜世未改 「卜世」各本並作「十世」。

translations.literal: The allotted age not yet changed—"allotted age" (bu shi) in all editions reads "ten generations" (shi shi).
translations.idiomatic: The allotted age not yet changed—"allotted age" (bu shi) appears as "ten generations" (shi shi) in all editions.

sentences.zh: 按自西晉武帝至東晉安帝，已十四世，言十世，無據。

translations.literal: From Western Jin Emperor Wu to Eastern Jin Emperor An is already fourteen generations; to speak of ten generations has no basis.
translations.idiomatic: From Western Jin Emperor Wu to Eastern Jin Emperor An is already fourteen generations; "ten generations" has no basis.

sentences.zh: 「十世」當是「卜世」之誤，今改正。

translations.literal: "Ten generations" must be an error for "allotted age"; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: "Ten generations" is an error for "allotted age"; corrected here.

sentences.zh: 去秋遣康之送還司馬君者 「君」各本並作「軍」，據晉書譙剛王遜傳玄孫休之附傳、元龜七二五改。

translations.literal: Last autumn Kangzhi was sent to return him to the Master of Records—"lord" (jun) in all editions reads "army" (jun); corrected according to the Jin shu biography of Prince Qiao Gang Wang Xun, great-grandson Xun, appendix biography of Xiuzhi, and Yuan gui 725.
translations.idiomatic: Last autumn Kangzhi was sent to return him to the Master of Records—"lord" (jun) is written "army" (jun) in all editions; corrected per the Jin shu and Yuan gui 725.

sentences.zh: 此公之大節 各本並脫「大」字，據南史、建康實錄補。

translations.literal: This is the great integrity of the Duke—all editions omit the character "great"; supplied according to the Nan shi and Veritable Records of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: This is the Duke's great integrity—all editions omit "great"; supplied from the Nan shi and Veritable Records of Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 一朝掃滌 「滌」各本並作「濟」，據南史、建康實錄改。

translations.literal: Swept clean in a morning—"swept" (di) in all editions reads "crossed" (ji); corrected according to the Nan shi and Veritable Records of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Swept clean in a morning—"swept" (di) is written "crossed" (ji) in all editions; corrected per the Nan shi and Veritable Records of Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 今命使持節兼太尉尚書左僕射晉寧縣五等男湛授相國印綬 各本脫「今」字、「兼」字，並據南史、建康實錄補。

translations.literal: Now command the Bearer of the Staff, concurrently Grand Commandant, Master of Writing Left Vice Director, and Baron of the fifth rank of Jinning county Zhan to confer the Chancellor of State seal and cord—all editions omit "now" and "concurrently"; both supplied according to the Nan shi and Veritable Records of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Now command Zhan, Bearer of the Staff, Grand Commandant, and Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, to confer the Chancellor of State seal and cord—all editions omit "now" and "concurrently"; supplied from the Nan shi and Veritable Records of Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 金虎符第一至第五左 「第五」各本作「第十」，據南史改。

translations.literal: Gold tiger tallies first through fifth on the left—"fifth" in all editions reads "tenth"; corrected according to the Nan shi.
translations.idiomatic: Gold tiger tallies one through five on the left—"fifth" is written "tenth" in all editions; corrected per the Nan shi.

sentences.zh: 其以相國總百揆 各本並脫「以」字，據南史、建康實錄補。

translations.literal: Let him as Chancellor of State oversee the hundred offices—all editions omit "as"; supplied according to the Nan shi and Veritable Records of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Let him as Chancellor of State oversee all government—all editions omit "as"; supplied from the Nan shi and Veritable Records of Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 上送所假節侍中貂蟬中外都督太傅太尉印綬 各本並脫「貂蟬」二字，據南史、建康實錄補。

translations.literal: He shall return the borrowed staff, Palace Attendants insignia, and seals of Grand Tutor and Grand Commandant of the inner and outer command—all editions omit the two characters "sable cicada"; supplied according to the Nan shi and Veritable Records of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: He shall return the borrowed staff, Palace Attendants sable-cicada insignia, and seals of Grand Tutor and Grand Commandant—all editions omit "sable cicada"; supplied from the Nan shi and Veritable Records of Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 孫虨宋書考論云：「按宋、齊志皆不見侍中印綬，蓋但給朝服武冠貂蟬而巳。

translations.literal: Sun Biao in his Critical Discussion of the Song shu says: "According to the Song and Qi offices, neither shows the Palace Attendants seal and cord; probably only court robes, martial cap, and sable cicada were given.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Biao notes: "The Song and Qi offices lists show no Palace Attendants seal and cord; likely only court robes, martial cap, and sable cicada were granted.

sentences.zh: 南史侍中下有貂蟬二字，是。」

translations.literal: The Nan shi has the two characters sable cicada below Palace Attendant—that is correct."
translations.idiomatic: The Nan shi has sable cicada below Palace Attendant—that is correct."

sentences.zh: 置宋國侍中黃門侍郎尚書左丞郎隨大使奉迎 「郎」三朝本、北監本、毛本、局本同。

translations.literal: Establish in the state of Song Palace Attendants, Gentlemen of the Yellow Gate, Left Assistant of the Masters of Writing, and Gentlemen to follow the great envoy in welcoming—"Gentlemen" (lang) is the same in the Three Dynasties edition, Beijian edition, Mao edition, and Bureau edition.
translations.idiomatic: Establish Palace Attendants, Gentlemen of the Yellow Gate, the Left Assistant of the Masters of Writing, and Gentlemen in Song to follow the great envoy in welcoming—"Gentlemen" (lang) is the same in the Three Dynasties, Beijian, Mao, and Bureau editions.

sentences.zh: 殿本、南史作「相」。

translations.literal: The Palace Edition and Nan shi read "minister" (xiang).
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Edition and Nan shi read "minister" (xiang) instead.

sentences.zh: 李慈銘越縵堂日記補云：「當作即隨大使奉迎。」

translations.literal: Li Ciming in his Supplement to the Diary of the Yue Man Hall says: "It should read immediately follow the great envoy in welcoming."
translations.idiomatic: Li Ciming notes: "It should read immediately follow the great envoy in welcoming."

sentences.zh: 風雲玄感 「玄」各本並作「言」，據局本、文選、建康實錄、元龜二一０改。

translations.literal: Wind and cloud mysteriously responsive—"mysterious" (xuan) in all editions reads "words" (yan); corrected according to the Bureau edition, Wen xuan, Veritable Records of Jiankang, and Yuan gui 210.
translations.idiomatic: Wind and cloud mysteriously responsive—"mysterious" (xuan) is written "words" (yan) in all editions; corrected per the Bureau edition, Wen xuan, Veritable Records of Jiankang, and Yuan gui 210.

sentences.zh: 以徐州之海陵北東海北譙北梁豫州之新蔡兗州之北陳留司州之陳郡汝南潁川滎陽十郡增宋國 「北東海」上之「北」字，各本並脫去。

translations.literal: Adding to the state of Song the ten commanderies Hailing of Xuzhou, Northern Donghai, Northern Qiao, Northern Liang of Yuzhou, Xincai, Northern Chenliu of Yanzhou, Chen commandery, Runan, Yingchuan, and Xingyang of Sizhou—the character "northern" above "Donghai" was lost in all editions.
translations.idiomatic: Adding to Song ten commanderies: Hailing of Xuzhou, Northern Donghai, Northern Qiao, Northern Liang of Yuzhou, Xincai, Northern Chenliu of Yanzhou, Chen, Runan, Yingchuan, and Xingyang of Sizhou—the "northern" before "Donghai" was lost in all editions.

sentences.zh: 據南史、建康實錄補。

translations.literal: Supplied according to the Nan shi and Veritable Records of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Supplied from the Nan shi and Veritable Records of Jiankang.
